# Error and status taxonomy (contract for the UI, the ledger and the evidence)

> **Status (2026-09-12 19:45 EDT): contract, not yet implemented.** Defined in
> `packages/common/faultline_common/schemas.py`; neither the harness nor sandbox-env emits these fields yet
> (`PLAN.md` §2.11, lead implementing). Until they do, a UI must render them as absent/unknown, never infer them.

Two questions must be answerable for every failure a run shows: **who caused it** (`origin`) and
**which layer really failed** (`layer`). The agent never gets these; the UI always does.

## `ErrorClass` (on every `tool.result` with `is_error`, on `fault.fired`, on `RunRecord.error_class`)

```json
{"origin": "injected|staged|real", "layer": "boundary|filesystem|sandbox|transport|harness|model|gym",
 "code": "ENOENT|EACCES|ETIMEDOUT|EINVAL|ESANDBOX|ETRANSPORT|EHARNESS|EMODEL|EGYM|EINTERNAL|ENOEPISODE",
 "kind": "missing_file|denied_write|ack_lost|null", "label": "<fixed string below>",
 "outcome_known": true|false, "side_effect_applied": true|false|null, "detail": "…"}
```

| origin / layer | code(s) | label (render verbatim) | outcome_known | side effect |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| injected / boundary | ENOENT | `simulated: missing file (file still on disk)` | true | no |
| injected / boundary | EACCES | `simulated: write denied (nothing written)` | true | no |
| injected / boundary | ETIMEDOUT | `simulated: lost ack (write landed; response withheld)` | **false** | **yes** |
| staged / filesystem | ENOENT | `staged: file absent since reset` | true | n/a |
| real / filesystem | ENOENT, EACCES, EINVAL | `real: OS error in sandbox` | true | no |
| real / sandbox | ESANDBOX | `real: sandbox terminated or unavailable` | true | no |
| real / transport | ETRANSPORT, ETIMEDOUT | `real: transport failure harness<->sandbox-env (outcome unknown)` | **false** | unknown |
| real / harness | EHARNESS | `real: harness worker interrupted mid-call (outcome unknown)` | **false** | unknown (ledger has truth after the fact) |
| real / model | EMODEL | `real: model API error` | true | — |
| real / gym | EGYM | `real: gym control-plane failure` | true | — |
| real / boundary | EINTERNAL, ENOEPISODE | `real: internal error in sandbox-env` | true | no |

UI guidance: badge colour by `origin` (injected = amber "simulated", staged = amber "staged", real
= red "real"); show `label`; when `outcome_known: false` add "verify before retrying"; when the
ledger later resolves `side_effect_applied`, show it ("the write had landed").

## Events

- `fault.fired` — `FaultFired` + `origin` (`injected` or `staged`). Never `real`.
- `interruption` — `Interruption` (always real): `{step, layer, code, label, tool_use_id?, tool?, path?, outcome_known, planned, resumed, worker_generation, at, detail}`. `planned: true` means a scenario `harness_faults` entry triggered it (a deliberate real failure).
- `run.resumed` — `{worker_generation, resumed_from_event_id, dangling_tool_use_id?, resumed_at}` emitted by the worker that picked the run up.
- `tool.result` — `data.error_class` present iff `is_error`; `data.fault` (FaultFired) present iff a fault fired for this call.

## Run status

| status | meaning | score |
|---|---|---|
| `ok` | the agent submitted or ended; evaluation succeeded | number |
| `truncated` | step budget exhausted; still evaluated | number |
| `unevaluated` | the loop finished but `evaluate` failed (`error_class.layer: gym` or `sandbox`) — **not** the agent's fault | null |
| `interrupted` | a real interruption ended the run and no worker resumed it | null |
| `error` | the harness could not run the episode (model auth, reset failed, bug) | null |

`RunRecord.interruptions[]` lists every real interruption, `worker_generation` is 1 + the number of
resumes; a resumed run can still end `ok` (that is the point of the `worker-crash` scenario).

## Scenario metadata

`Scenario.fault_kinds` (injected kinds in play) and `Scenario.harness_faults[]` (planned **real**
interruptions: `{kind: worker_crash|transport_abort, tool, path, nth, after_ms}`) are public so the
UI can show "includes a real harness interruption" on the card. The agent is never told either.

## Ledger (released at evaluate)

`LedgerEntry.origin` (`injected|staged|real`, only when `outcome != ok`), `error_code`, and
`interrupted: true` when the harness reported that it never received the response (`POST
/episodes/{id}/interruptions`). `verified_before_rewrite` treats `ack_lost` rows and `interrupted`
rows identically.

"""Shared wire contracts for Faultline (pydantic v2).

Three consumers: services/sandbox-env (gym + MCP), services/agent-harness (model loop + API),
scripts/ (smoke + evidence). apps/web mirrors these in src/lib/types.ts — keep both in sync.

Sections: faults & scenarios · MCP tool I/O · ledger · gym REST · harness runs/events · persistence · health.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

from typing import Any, Literal

from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

FaultKind = Literal["missing_file", "denied_write", "ack_lost"]
FaultMode = Literal["sticky", "transient"]

class FaultSpec(BaseModel):
    """One injected failure. Lives ONLY in sandbox-env state (never inside the command sandbox).

    sticky    : applied at reset (e.g. the file is really deleted) and never lifted.
    transient : intercepted at the tool boundary for the first `hits` matching calls, then lifted.
    """

    kind: FaultKind
    path: str = Field(description="workspace-relative path the fault targets")
    mode: FaultMode = "transient"
    hits: int | None = Field(default=1, description="matching calls affected before the fault lifts (None = forever)")
    delay_ms: int = Field(default=3000, description="ack_lost only: how long to hold the response before failing it")

class FaultPlan(BaseModel):
    faults: list[FaultSpec] = Field(default_factory=list)

HarnessFaultKind = Literal["worker_crash", "transport_abort"]

class Scenario(BaseModel):
    """Public scenario fields (safe to show the agent and the browser)."""

    id: str
    title: str
    description: str = Field(description="one-paragraph human description shown in the UI")
    task_prompt: str = Field(description="what the agent is asked to do (goes into the user turn)")
    max_steps: int = 20
    fault_kinds: list[FaultKind] = Field(default_factory=list, description="which kinds are in play (not where/when)")
    harness_faults: list["HarnessFault"] = Field(default_factory=list, description="REAL interruptions the harness inflicts on itself (see HarnessFault)")
    checks: list["CheckSpec"] = Field(default_factory=list, description="what the grader will look for (public: id, description, weight)")
    faults_public: list["FaultPublic"] = Field(default_factory=list, description="fault classes in play (kind, layer, origin, description) — never paths, hits or timing")

class CheckSpec(BaseModel):
    id: str
    description: str
    weight: float = 1.0

class FaultPublic(BaseModel):
    kind: FaultKind | HarnessFaultKind
    origin: ErrorOrigin
    layer: ErrorLayer
    description: str

class HarnessFault(BaseModel):
    """A real interruption the harness inflicts on ITSELF at a chosen call (chaos trigger, real failure mode).

    worker_crash    : after dispatching the matching tool call and waiting `after_ms`, the run_episode
                      process exits hard (os._exit) — the request is already at sandbox-env, so the
                      side effect completes; a fresh worker resumes the run from the persisted events.
    transport_abort : the in-flight HTTP request is cancelled client-side after `after_ms`; the server
                      still completes it; the agent gets ETRANSPORT with outcome unknown.
    """

    kind: HarnessFaultKind
    tool: ToolName = "write_file"
    path: str
    nth: int = Field(default=1, ge=1, description="fire on the nth matching call")
    after_ms: int = Field(default=400, ge=0, description="delay after dispatch before interrupting (lets the request reach the server)")

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------- MCP tool I/O

ToolName = Literal["run_command", "read_file", "write_file", "list_dir"]
ErrorCode = Literal[
    # OS/HTTP-style codes the AGENT sees (the same text whether injected or real):
    "ENOENT",      # no such file or directory
    "EACCES",      # permission denied
    "ETIMEDOUT",   # the response never arrived (ack lost); the operation MAY have completed
    "EINVAL",      # bad argument (path outside /workspace, bad mode, is-a-directory)
    # Real-failure codes (never injected; only the layer that really failed produces them):
    "ESANDBOX",    # the Modal Sandbox is gone/unavailable (terminated, not found, exec failed)
    "ETRANSPORT",  # harness <-> sandbox-env HTTP/MCP failure (connection reset, 5xx, client abort)
    "EHARNESS",    # the harness worker itself was interrupted while the call was in flight
    "EMODEL",      # Anthropic API failure that ended the turn
    "EGYM",        # gym control-plane (reset/observe/evaluate/delete) failure
    "EINTERNAL",   # unexpected exception inside sandbox-env (a bug; see detail)
    "ENOEPISODE",  # missing/unknown X-Faultline-Episode header
]

# Provenance: WHO caused a failure. The agent never sees this; ledger, events and UI do.
ErrorOrigin = Literal[
    "injected",  # intercepted at the tool boundary by the fault plan; nothing real failed
    "staged",    # the scenario really changed the world at reset (e.g. deleted a file); the error is a real OS error
    "real",      # unplanned failure of a real component (sandbox, transport, harness, model, gym, filesystem)
]
ErrorLayer = Literal["filesystem", "sandbox", "transport", "harness", "model", "gym", "boundary"]

class ErrorClass(BaseModel):
    """Differentiated classification of one failure, for humans and the UI (never shown to the agent).

    Fixed `label` vocabulary (apps/web renders these verbatim; see docs/error-taxonomy.md):
      injected/boundary  "simulated: missing file (file still on disk)"
                         "simulated: write denied (nothing written)"
                         "simulated: lost ack (write landed; response withheld)"
      staged/filesystem  "staged: file absent since reset"
      real/filesystem    "real: OS error in sandbox"
      real/sandbox       "real: sandbox terminated or unavailable"
      real/transport     "real: transport failure harness<->sandbox-env (outcome unknown)"
      real/harness       "real: harness worker interrupted mid-call (outcome unknown)"
      real/model         "real: model API error"
      real/gym           "real: gym control-plane failure"
      real/boundary      "real: internal error in sandbox-env"
    """

    origin: ErrorOrigin
    layer: ErrorLayer
    code: ErrorCode
    kind: FaultKind | None = Field(default=None, description="injected/staged only: which fault kind")
    label: str
    outcome_known: bool = Field(description="False when the side effect may or may not have happened (ack lost, transport, harness interruption)")
    side_effect_applied: bool | None = Field(default=None, description="ground truth from the ledger when known: did the write/command actually run?")
    detail: str | None = None

STDIO_CAP = 8_000  # chars per stream in run_command
CONTENT_CAP = 32_000  # chars in read_file

class RunCommandInput(BaseModel):
    command: str = Field(description="bash -lc <command>, cwd=/workspace")
    timeout_s: int = Field(default=30, ge=1, le=60)

class RunCommandOutput(BaseModel):
    stdout: str
    stderr: str
    exit_code: int
    duration_ms: int
    truncated: bool = False

class ReadFileInput(BaseModel):
    path: str

class ReadFileOutput(BaseModel):
    path: str
    content: str
    size: int
    sha256: str
    truncated: bool = False

class WriteFileInput(BaseModel):
    path: str
    content: str
    mode: Literal["overwrite", "append"] = "overwrite"

class WriteFileOutput(BaseModel):
    path: str
    bytes_written: int
    sha256: str = Field(description="sha256 of the whole file after the write")

class ListDirInput(BaseModel):
    path: str = "."

class DirEntry(BaseModel):
    name: str
    type: Literal["file", "dir", "other"]
    size: int | None = None

class ListDirOutput(BaseModel):
    path: str
    entries: list[DirEntry]

class ToolError(BaseModel):
    """Returned (as the tool result text, is_error=True) for both real and injected failures.

    The agent cannot tell injected from real: same shape, same wording as the OS/HTTP layer would use.
    """

    error: str = Field(description="human-readable, OS/HTTP-style, e.g. 'cat: config/settings.json: No such file or directory'")
    code: ErrorCode
    path: str | None = None
    detail: str | None = None

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------- ledger (private to sandbox-env; public subset via observe)

class FaultFired(BaseModel):
    step: int
    kind: FaultKind
    path: str
    mode: FaultMode
    origin: ErrorOrigin = Field(default="injected", description="injected (intercepted) or staged (sticky missing_file hit for real)")
    layer: ErrorLayer = Field(default="boundary", description="boundary for injected, filesystem for staged")
    description: str = Field(default="", description="one plain-language sentence for the UI, e.g. 'the write was applied but the acknowledgement was withheld'")

class LedgerEntry(BaseModel):
    step: int
    ts: str
    tool: ToolName
    args_digest: str = Field(description="sha256[:12] of canonical json args")
    path: str | None = Field(default=None, description="primary path the call touched, if determinable")
    command: str | None = Field(default=None, description="run_command only")
    mutating: bool = False
    fault: FaultFired | None = None
    outcome: Literal["ok", "error", "short_circuit", "ack_lost", "unknown"] = Field(description="unknown = the sandbox may or may not have applied it (WorkspaceError/timeout after dispatch)")
    exit_code: int | None = None
    duration_ms: int = 0
    origin: ErrorOrigin | None = Field(default=None, description="set when outcome != ok: injected | staged | real")
    error_code: ErrorCode | None = None
    interrupted: bool = Field(default=False, description="the harness reported (POST /episodes/{id}/interruptions) that it never received this call's response")

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------- gym REST

class FileEntry(BaseModel):
    path: str
    size: int
    sha256: str
    status: Literal["added", "modified", "deleted", "unchanged"] = "unchanged"

class ResetRequest(BaseModel):
    scenario_id: str
    seed: int | None = None

class ResetResponse(BaseModel):
    episode_id: str
    scenario: Scenario
    workspace_root: str = "/workspace"
    files: list[FileEntry]
    sandbox_id: str | None = Field(default=None, description="for ops/evidence only; never given to the model")
    control_token: str | None = Field(default=None, description="per-episode bearer minted at reset; required as header X-Faultline-Control on observe/evaluate/delete/interruptions. Held by the harness only — never sent to the model or the browser, never listed by GET /episodes")

class FileDiff(BaseModel):
    path: str
    unified: str

class ObserveResponse(BaseModel):
    episode_id: str
    step: int
    files: list[FileEntry]
    diffs: list[FileDiff] = Field(default_factory=list)
    faults_fired: list[FaultFired] = Field(default_factory=list, description="only faults that already fired; pending ones stay hidden")
    done: bool = False

class Check(BaseModel):
    id: str
    ok: bool
    weight: float = 1.0
    detail: str = ""

class TestsResult(BaseModel):
    passed: int = 0
    failed: int = 0
    errors: int = 0
    output: str = ""

class EvaluateResponse(BaseModel):
    episode_id: str
    score: float = Field(ge=0, le=100, description="60*tests_pass + 40*weighted recovery checks")
    passed: bool = Field(description="hidden tests all pass")
    checks: list[Check]
    tests: TestsResult
    ledger: list[LedgerEntry] = Field(default_factory=list, description="full ledger, released only at evaluate time")

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------- harness runs & events

ToolOutcome = Literal[
    "executed",      # the sandbox ran it and it succeeded
    "failed",        # the sandbox ran it and reported failure (non-zero exit, real ENOENT/EACCES)
    "not_executed",  # refused/short-circuited before the sandbox saw it (injected EACCES/ENOENT, EINVAL, ESANDBOX)
    "unknown",       # may or may not have run (ack lost, transport failure, harness interruption)
]

EventType = Literal[
    "run.started",
    "episode.reset",
    "turn.text",
    "tool.call",
    "tool.result",
    "fault.fired",
    "workspace.diff",
    "episode.evaluated",
    "run.finished",
    "log",
    "llm.call",
    "turn.thinking",
    "interruption",
    "run.resumed",
    "episode.sandbox",
]

class Event(BaseModel):
    """Append-only, single-writer (run_episode). `id` is the 0-based sequence within the run and is
    what SSE uses as the event id / Last-Event-ID.

    data shapes by type:
      run.started       {scenario_id, model, seed, max_steps, anthropic_workspace?: masked, sandbox_env_url, worker_generation}
      episode.reset     {episode_id, files: [FileEntry], task_prompt, sandbox_id (short), attempt (1 = first provisioning), scenario, workspace_root}
      turn.text         {text}
      tool.call         {tool, input, tool_use_id, mutating}
      tool.result       {tool_use_id, tool, output: str, is_error: bool, duration_ms, fault?: FaultFired,
                         outcome: executed|failed|not_executed|unknown, error_class?: ErrorClass (iff is_error),
                         error_code?: str (compat), attempts: int (harness retries of this call; 1 = none),
                         sandbox: {id: short, alive: bool}, summary?, synthetic?: bool (resume-generated), reported_to_gym?: bool}
      fault.fired       FaultFired
      workspace.diff    {files: [FileEntry], diffs: [FileDiff]}
      episode.evaluated EvaluateResponse
      run.finished      {status, usage: {input_tokens, output_tokens}, duration_ms, error?: str,
                         evaluation_status: ok|failed|skipped, evaluation_error?: str, steps, score?,
                         error_class?: ErrorClass (present whenever status is unevaluated|interrupted|error), worker_generation, interruptions}
      log               {svc, lvl, ev, msg, ...}   (unified log line mirrored into the stream)
      llm.call          {attempt, model, stop_reason?, request_id?, usage: Usage-shaped {input_tokens, output_tokens, cache_read_input_tokens?, cache_creation_input_tokens?}, duration_ms, error?}
      turn.thinking     {text}   (summarised thinking, models that expose it)
      interruption      Interruption   (a REAL interruption: origin is always "real")
      run.resumed       {worker_generation, resumed_from_event_id, dangling_tool_use_id?, resumed_at, step, dropped_thinking_blocks}
      episode.sandbox   {sandbox_id, status: alive|terminated|replaced, reason, step}   (the environment noticed the worker changed)
    Every tool.result with is_error carries data.error_class: ErrorClass; every fault.fired carries origin.
    """

    id: int
    ts: str
    run_id: str
    type: EventType
    step: int | None = None
    data: dict[str, Any] = Field(default_factory=dict)

RunStatus = Literal[
    "queued",
    "running",
    "ok",           # agent submitted / ended, evaluation succeeded
    "truncated",    # step budget exhausted (still evaluated)
    "unevaluated",  # loop finished but evaluate() failed — NOT ok, NOT an agent error
    "interrupted",  # a real interruption ended the run and no worker could continue it (sandbox gone, retries exhausted, ...)
    "error",        # the harness could not run the episode (model auth, gym reset failure, bug)
]

class Interruption(BaseModel):
    """A real interruption observed by the harness (origin is always real)."""

    step: int | None = None
    layer: ErrorLayer
    code: ErrorCode
    label: str
    tool_use_id: str | None = Field(default=None, description="the in-flight tool call, if any")
    tool: ToolName | None = None
    path: str | None = None
    outcome_known: bool = False
    planned: bool = Field(default=False, description="True when a HarnessFault in the scenario triggered it (still a real failure)")
    resumed: bool = Field(default=False, description="a new worker picked the run up afterwards")
    worker_generation: int = Field(default=1, description="which worker observed it")
    at: str
    detail: str | None = None

MODEL_ALLOWLIST = ["claude-haiku-4-5", "claude-sonnet-5", "claude-opus-5"]
DEFAULT_MODEL = "claude-haiku-4-5"

class RunRequest(BaseModel):
    scenario_id: str
    model: str | None = Field(default=None, description="must be in MODEL_ALLOWLIST; None = ANTHROPIC_MODEL env")
    seed: int | None = None
    max_steps: int | None = Field(default=None, ge=1, le=40)
    task_prompt: str | None = Field(default=None, description="overrides the scenario task prompt (the user edited it in the composer); wins over the scenario default")
    harness_faults: list[HarnessFault] | None = Field(default=None, description="overrides the scenario harness_faults for this run (ops/testing)")

class Usage(BaseModel):
    input_tokens: int = 0
    output_tokens: int = 0
    cache_read_input_tokens: int = 0
    cache_creation_input_tokens: int = 0

class RunRecord(BaseModel):
    run_id: str
    status: RunStatus
    scenario_id: str
    model: str
    seed: int | None = None
    max_steps: int = 20
    episode_id: str | None = None
    created_at: str
    finished_at: str | None = None
    events: list[Event] = Field(default_factory=list)
    evaluation: EvaluateResponse | None = None
    usage: Usage = Field(default_factory=Usage)
    error: str | None = None
    conversation_id: str | None = None
    user_id: str | None = None
    task_prompt: str | None = None
    steps: int | None = None
    summary: str | None = Field(default=None, description="the agent's submit summary")
    error_class: ErrorClass | None = Field(default=None, description="why status is error/unevaluated/interrupted")
    interruptions: list[Interruption] = Field(default_factory=list)
    worker_generation: int = Field(default=1, description="1 + number of resumes")

class InterruptionReport(BaseModel):
    """POST /episodes/{id}/interruptions — the harness tells the gym it never got a response to a call,
    so the ledger can mark that entry `interrupted` and the grader can require verification before
    the next write to the same path (same rule as ack_lost)."""

    tool: ToolName
    path: str | None = None
    args_digest: str | None = Field(default=None, description="sha256[:12] of canonical json args, to match the ledger row")
    layer: ErrorLayer
    code: ErrorCode
    at: str

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------- persistence (harness Store; ARCHITECTURE.md §4)

class User(BaseModel):
    id: str = Field(description="u_<uuid4>, minted by the browser, sent as X-Faultline-User")
    created_at: str
    last_seen_at: str
    user_agent: str | None = None

class RunSummary(BaseModel):
    id: str
    status: RunStatus
    scenario_id: str
    model: str
    score: float | None = None
    created_at: str
    finished_at: str | None = None

class Conversation(BaseModel):
    id: str = Field(description="c_<hex ms><12 hex>")
    user_id: str
    scenario_id: str
    title: str
    created_at: str
    updated_at: str
    archived_at: str | None = None

class ConversationSummary(BaseModel):
    id: str
    title: str
    scenario_id: str
    created_at: str
    updated_at: str
    last_run: RunSummary | None = Field(default=None, description="newest run; `id` is the run id")

class Block(BaseModel):
    """One content block of a transcript message (Anthropic content-block shape, flattened).

    Wire form carries parsed objects (`input`, `fault`); the Store keeps them as JSON text columns.
    """

    id: str
    message_id: str | None = None
    seq: int
    type: Literal["text", "thinking", "tool_use", "tool_result"]
    text: str | None = None
    tool_name: str | None = None
    tool_use_id: str | None = None
    input: dict[str, Any] | None = Field(default=None, description="tool_use input, parsed")
    is_error: bool | None = None
    exit_code: int | None = None
    duration_ms: int | None = None
    fault: FaultFired | None = None
    truncated: bool = False

class Message(BaseModel):
    id: str
    conversation_id: str
    run_id: str
    seq: int
    role: Literal["user", "assistant"]
    step: int | None = None
    created_at: str
    blocks: list[Block] = Field(default_factory=list)

class LlmCall(BaseModel):
    id: str
    run_id: str
    step: int
    attempt: int = 1
    model: str
    request_id: str | None = None
    stop_reason: str | None = None
    input_tokens: int | None = None
    output_tokens: int | None = None
    cache_read_tokens: int | None = None
    cache_write_tokens: int | None = None
    started_at: str
    duration_ms: int | None = None
    error: str | None = None

class ConversationDetail(BaseModel):
    conversation: Conversation
    runs: list[RunSummary] = Field(default_factory=list)
    messages: list[Message] = Field(default_factory=list)

class CreateConversationRequest(BaseModel):
    scenario_id: str
    title: str | None = None

class ConversationRunRequest(BaseModel):
    model: str | None = None
    seed: int | None = None
    max_steps: int | None = Field(default=None, ge=1, le=40)
    task_prompt: str | None = None

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------- health

class Health(BaseModel):
    svc: Literal["harness", "sandbox-env", "web"]
    ok: bool
    version: str = "0.1.0"
    has_provider_key: bool = Field(default=False, description="MUST be false on every web-facing function")
    model_default: str | None = None
    sandbox_env_url: str | None = None
    detail: dict[str, Any] = Field(default_factory=dict)

9	 *   - `mutating` / `read` classification and argv-token path matching approximate
10	 *     services/sandbox-env/GRADING.md so the badges in the UI line up with what the grader looks

12	 *   - `recovered`: a faulted call is marked recovered when a later call on the same path succeeds
13	 *     AND a successful *read* of that path happened at or before that success. Retrying blind does

175	  /** Last reported liveness; null until something reports it. */
176	  sandboxAlive: boolean | null
177	  /** `episode.reset.data.attempt` — >1 when the harness re-provisioned the workspace. */
178	  resetAttempt: number | null
179	  /** `run.finished.data.evaluation_status` / `evaluation_error`. */
180	  evaluationStatus: EvaluationStatus | null
181	  evaluationError: string | null
182	}
183

186	    runId: null,
187	    status: 'queued',
188	    scenarioId: null,
189	    model: null,
190	    seed: null,
191	    maxSteps: 20,
192	    episodeId: null,
193	    taskPrompt: null,
194	    anthropicWorkspace: null,
195	    startedAt: null,
196	    finishedAt: null,
197	    step: 0,
198	    usage: { input_tokens: 0, output_tokens: 0 },
199	    llmCalls: [],
200	    steps: [],
201	    files: [],
202	    diffs: [],
203	    faults: [],
204	    evaluation: null,
205	    logs: [],
206	    error: null,
207	    durationMs: null,
208	    lastEventId: -1,
209	    eventCount: 0,
210	    interruptions: [],
211	    resumes: [],
212	    workerGeneration: 1,
213	    errorClass: null,
214	    scenario: null,
215	    sandboxEvents: [],
216	    sandboxId: null,
217	    sandboxAlive: null,
218	    resetAttempt: null,
219	    evaluationStatus: null,

223	
224	// --------------------------------------------------------------------------- path / verb helpers
225	
226	/** `"./src/x.py"`, `'/workspace/src/x.py'`, `"src/x.py"` all normalise to `src/x.py`. */
227	export function normalisePath(raw: string): string {
228	  let s = raw.trim()
229	  if (s.length >= 2 && ((s[0] === '"' && s.endsWith('"')) || (s[0] === "'" && s.endsWith("'")))) {
230	    s = s.slice(1, -1)
231	  }
232	  s = s.replace(/^\/workspace\//, '')
233	  s = s.replace(/^\.\//, '')
234	  s = s.replace(/^\/+/, '')
235	  // `ls src/ratelimiter/` and `read_file src/ratelimiter` name the same thing.
236	  if (s.length > 1) s = s.replace(/\/+$/, '')
237	  return s
238	}
239	
240	/** Cheap argv split: whitespace, honouring single/double quotes. Good enough for token matching. */
241	export function argvTokens(command: string): string[] {
242	  const out: string[] = []
243	  const re = /"([^"]*)"|'([^']*)'|(\S+)/g
244	  let m: RegExpExecArray | null
245	  while ((m = re.exec(command)) !== null) {
246	    out.push(m[1] ?? m[2] ?? m[3] ?? '')
247	  }
248	  return out
249	}
250	
251	const MUTATING_RE =
252	  /(>>?|\btee\b|\bsed\s+-i|\brm\b|\bmv\b|\bcp\b|\btouch\b|\bmkdir\b|\btruncate\b|\bpatch\b|\bgit\s+(apply|checkout|reset|restore))/
253	
254	const PY_WRITE_RE = /python[0-9.]*\s+.*-c[\s\S]*open\([\s\S]*['"][wa]\+?['"]/
255	
256	const READ_VERB_RE =
257	  /\b(cat|head|tail|grep|rg|wc|diff|less|cmp|sha256sum|md5sum|ls|stat|find|pytest|nl|od)\b|\bsed\s+-n\b|python[0-9.]*\s+-m\s+pytest/
258	
259	export function commandIsMutating(command: string): boolean {
260	  return MUTATING_RE.test(command) || PY_WRITE_RE.test(command)
261	}
262	
263	export function commandIsRead(command: string): boolean {
264	  return !commandIsMutating(command) && READ_VERB_RE.test(command)
265	}
266	
267	/** Does this call touch `path`? Direct for path tools; argv-token match for run_command. */
268	export function callTouches(call: Pick<ToolCallView, 'tool' | 'command' | 'path'>, path: string): boolean {
269	  const target = normalisePath(path)
270	  if (call.tool === 'run_command') {
271	    if (!call.command) return false
272	    return argvTokens(call.command).some((t) => {
273	      const n = normalisePath(t)
274	      return n === target || n.endsWith(`/${target}`)
275	    })
276	  }
277	  return call.path !== null && call.path === target
278	}
279	
280	function inputPath(tool: string, input: Record<string, unknown>): string | null {
281	  const raw = input?.path
282	  if (typeof raw === 'string' && raw.length > 0) return normalisePath(raw)
283	  if (tool === 'list_dir') return '.'
284	  return null
285	}
286	
287	export interface CallClassification {
288	  path: string | null
289	  command: string | null
290	  mutating: boolean
291	  read: boolean
292	}
293	
294	/**
295	 * Path / verb classification of a tool call from its name and input. Exported so the persisted
296	 * transcript path (transcript.ts) classifies exactly as the live fold does.
297	 */
298	export function classifyCall(tool: string, input: Record<string, unknown>): CallClassification {
299	  return classify(tool, input)
300	}
301	
302	function classify(tool: string, input: Record<string, unknown>): CallClassification {
303	  if (tool === 'run_command') {
304	    const command = typeof input?.command === 'string' ? (input.command as string) : null
305	    return {
306	      path: null,
307	      command,
308	      mutating: command ? commandIsMutating(command) : false,
309	      read: command ? commandIsRead(command) : false,
310	    }
311	  }
312	  if (tool === 'write_file') {
313	    return { path: inputPath(tool, input), command: null, mutating: true, read: false }
314	  }
315	  if (tool === 'read_file' || tool === 'list_dir') {
316	    return { path: inputPath(tool, input), command: null, mutating: false, read: true }
317	  }
318	  // `submit` and anything else the harness adds locally.
319	  return { path: inputPath(tool, input), command: null, mutating: false, read: false }
320	}
321	
322	// --------------------------------------------------------------------------- result parsing
323	
324	export function parseToolResult(
325	  toolUseId: string,
326	  output: string,
327	  isError: boolean,
328	  durationMs: number,
329	): ToolResultView {
330	  const base: ToolResultView = {
331	    toolUseId,
332	    output: output ?? '',
333	    isError,
334	    durationMs,
335	    stdout: null,
336	    stderr: null,
337	    content: null,
338	    exitCode: null,
339	    errorText: null,
340	    errorCode: null,
341	    truncated: false,
342	    bytesWritten: null,
343	    entries: null,
344	    errorClass: null,
345	    outcome: null,
346	    attempts: null,
347	    sandbox: null,
348	  }
349	  let parsed: unknown
350	  try {
351	    parsed = JSON.parse(output)
352	  } catch {
353	    if (isError) base.errorText = output
354	    return base
355	  }
356	  if (parsed === null || typeof parsed !== 'object' || Array.isArray(parsed)) return base
357	  const o = parsed as Record<string, unknown>
358	  if (typeof o.stdout === 'string') base.stdout = o.stdout
359	  if (typeof o.stderr === 'string') base.stderr = o.stderr
360	  if (typeof o.content === 'string') base.content = o.content
361	  if (typeof o.exit_code === 'number') base.exitCode = o.exit_code
362	  if (typeof o.truncated === 'boolean') base.truncated = o.truncated
363	  if (typeof o.bytes_written === 'number') base.bytesWritten = o.bytes_written
364	  if (typeof o.error === 'string') base.errorText = o.error
365	  if (typeof o.code === 'string' && (ERROR_CODES as readonly string[]).includes(o.code)) {
366	    base.errorCode = o.code as ErrorCode
367	  }
368	  if (Array.isArray(o.entries)) {
369	    base.entries = o.entries as ToolResultView['entries']
370	  }
371	  return base
372	}
373	
374	// --------------------------------------------------------------------------- recovery
375	
376	function flatten(steps: StepView[]): ToolCallView[] {
377	  const all: ToolCallView[] = []
378	  for (const s of steps) all.push(...s.calls)
379	  all.sort((a, b) => a.seq - b.seq)
380	  return all
381	}
382	
383	/**
384	 * Recompute `recovered` for every faulted call. Cheap (a run is tens of calls) and keeps the flag
385	 * correct as later events arrive.
386	 */
387	export function applyRecovery(steps: StepView[]): StepView[] {
388	  const all = flatten(steps)
389	  const recoveredIds = new Set<string>()
390	
391	  for (const c of all) {
392	    if (!c.fault) continue
393	    const path = normalisePath(c.fault.path || c.path || '')
394	    if (!path) continue
395	    const later = all.filter((x) => x.seq > c.seq)
396	    const successes = later.filter((x) => x.result && !x.result.isError && callTouches(x, path))
397	    if (successes.length === 0) continue
398	    const firstSuccessSeq = successes[0]!.seq
399	    const verified = later.some(
400	      (x) => x.seq <= firstSuccessSeq && x.read && x.result && !x.result.isError && callTouches(x, path),
401	    )
402	    if (verified) recoveredIds.add(c.toolUseId)
403	  }
404	
405	  if (recoveredIds.size === 0) {
406	    return steps.map((s) =>
407	      s.calls.some((c) => c.recovered) ? { ...s, calls: s.calls.map((c) => ({ ...c, recovered: false })) } : s,
408	    )
409	  }
410	  return steps.map((s) => ({
411	    ...s,
412	    calls: s.calls.map((c) => {
413	      const next = recoveredIds.has(c.toolUseId)
414	      return c.recovered === next ? c : { ...c, recovered: next }
415	    }),
416	  }))
417	}
418	
419	// --------------------------------------------------------------------------- the fold
420	
421	function upsertStep(steps: StepView[], step: number): { steps: StepView[]; idx: number } {
422	  const idx = steps.findIndex((s) => s.step === step)
423	  if (idx >= 0) return { steps, idx }
424	  const next = [...steps, { step, thinking: null, texts: [], calls: [] }].sort((a, b) => a.step - b.step)
425	  return { steps: next, idx: next.findIndex((s) => s.step === step) }
426	}
427	
428	// --------------------------------------------------------------------------- usage
429	
430	function asUsage(v: unknown, fallback: Usage = { input_tokens: 0, output_tokens: 0 }): Usage {
431	  const o = asRecord(v)
432	  const out: Usage = {
433	    input_tokens: num(o.input_tokens, fallback.input_tokens),
434	    output_tokens: num(o.output_tokens, fallback.output_tokens),
435	  }
436	  const cr = typeof o.cache_read_input_tokens === 'number' ? o.cache_read_input_tokens : fallback.cache_read_input_tokens
437	  const cc =
438	    typeof o.cache_creation_input_tokens === 'number'
439	      ? o.cache_creation_input_tokens
440	      : fallback.cache_creation_input_tokens
441	  if (cr !== undefined) out.cache_read_input_tokens = cr
442	  if (cc !== undefined) out.cache_creation_input_tokens = cc
443	  return out
444	}
445	
446	/**
447	 * Sum token usage over LLM calls, counting only the LAST attempt of each step so a request that
448	 * was retried after a 429/5xx is not billed twice in the header.
449	 */
450	export function sumLlmUsage(calls: LlmCallView[]): Usage {
451	  const lastPerStep = new Map<number, LlmCallView>()
452	  for (const c of calls) {
453	    const prev = lastPerStep.get(c.step)
454	    if (!prev || c.attempt >= prev.attempt) lastPerStep.set(c.step, c)
455	  }
456	  const out: Usage = { input_tokens: 0, output_tokens: 0 }
457	  let cr = 0
458	  let cc = 0
459	  let sawCache = false
460	  for (const c of lastPerStep.values()) {
461	    out.input_tokens += c.usage.input_tokens
462	    out.output_tokens += c.usage.output_tokens
463	    if (typeof c.usage.cache_read_input_tokens === 'number') {
464	      cr += c.usage.cache_read_input_tokens
465	      sawCache = true
466	    }
467	    if (typeof c.usage.cache_creation_input_tokens === 'number') {
468	      cc += c.usage.cache_creation_input_tokens
469	      sawCache = true
470	    }
471	  }
472	  if (sawCache) {
473	    out.cache_read_input_tokens = cr
474	    out.cache_creation_input_tokens = cc
475	  }
476	  return out
477	}
478	
479	function usageIsEmpty(u: Usage | null | undefined): boolean {
480	  return !u || ((u.input_tokens ?? 0) === 0 && (u.output_tokens ?? 0) === 0)
481	}
482	
483	function asRecord(v: unknown): Record<string, unknown> {
484	  return v !== null && typeof v === 'object' && !Array.isArray(v) ? (v as Record<string, unknown>) : {}
485	}
486	
487	function num(v: unknown, fallback: number): number {
488	  return typeof v === 'number' && Number.isFinite(v) ? v : fallback
489	}
490	
491	function str(v: unknown): string | null {
492	  return typeof v === 'string' ? v : null
493	}
494	
495	function asOrigin(v: unknown): ErrorOrigin | null {
496	  return typeof v === 'string' && (ERROR_ORIGINS as readonly string[]).includes(v) ? (v as ErrorOrigin) : null
497	}
498	
499	function asLayer(v: unknown): ErrorLayer | null {
500	  return typeof v === 'string' && (ERROR_LAYERS as readonly string[]).includes(v) ? (v as ErrorLayer) : null
501	}
502	
503	function asCode(v: unknown): ErrorCode | null {
504	  return typeof v === 'string' && (ERROR_CODES as readonly string[]).includes(v) ? (v as ErrorCode) : null
505	}
506	
507	function asFault(v: unknown): FaultFired | null {
508	  const o = asRecord(v)
509	  if (typeof o.kind !== 'string' || typeof o.path !== 'string') return null
510	  const fault: FaultFired = {
511	    step: num(o.step, 0),
512	    kind: o.kind as FaultFired['kind'],
513	    path: o.path,
514	    mode: (o.mode as FaultFired['mode']) ?? 'transient',
515	  }
516	  const origin = asOrigin(o.origin)
517	  const layer = asLayer(o.layer)
518	  if (origin) fault.origin = origin
519	  if (layer) fault.layer = layer
520	  if (typeof o.description === 'string' && o.description.length > 0) fault.description = o.description
521	  return fault
522	}
523	
524	/** Structural check for an ErrorClass payload; anything short of (origin, layer, code, label) is ignored. */
525	export function asErrorClass(v: unknown): ErrorClass | null {
526	  const o = asRecord(v)
527	  const origin = asOrigin(o.origin)
528	  const layer = asLayer(o.layer)
529	  const code = asCode(o.code)
530	  if (!origin || !layer || !code || typeof o.label !== 'string') return null
531	  return {
532	    origin,
533	    layer,
534	    code,
535	    kind: typeof o.kind === 'string' ? (o.kind as ErrorClass['kind']) : null,
536	    label: o.label,
537	    // Unknown execution is not failed execution: only an explicit `true` counts as known.
538	    outcome_known: o.outcome_known === true,
539	    side_effect_applied: typeof o.side_effect_applied === 'boolean' ? o.side_effect_applied : null,
540	    detail: str(o.detail),
541	  }
542	}
543	
544	function asInterruption(v: unknown, fallbackStep: number | null): Interruption | null {
545	  const o = asRecord(v)
546	  const layer = asLayer(o.layer)
547	  const code = asCode(o.code)
548	  if (!layer || !code) return null
549	  return {
550	    step: typeof o.step === 'number' ? o.step : fallbackStep,
551	    layer,
552	    code,
553	    label: str(o.label) ?? '',
554	    tool_use_id: str(o.tool_use_id),
555	    tool: str(o.tool) as Interruption['tool'],
556	    path: str(o.path),
557	    outcome_known: o.outcome_known === true,
558	    planned: o.planned === true,
559	    resumed: o.resumed === true,
560	    worker_generation: Math.max(1, Math.trunc(num(o.worker_generation, 1))),
561	    at: str(o.at) ?? '',
562	    detail: str(o.detail),
563	  }
564	}
565	
566	function asToolOutcome(v: unknown): ToolOutcome | null {
567	  return v === 'executed' || v === 'failed' || v === 'not_executed' || v === 'unknown' ? v : null
568	}
569	
570	function asSandboxRef(v: unknown): { id: string; alive: boolean } | null {
571	  const o = asRecord(v)
572	  if (typeof o.id !== 'string') return null
573	  return { id: o.id, alive: o.alive !== false }
574	}
575	
576	function asScenario(v: unknown): Scenario | null {
577	  const o = asRecord(v)
578	  if (typeof o.id !== 'string' || typeof o.title !== 'string') return null
579	  return o as unknown as Scenario
580	}
581	
582	function sameInterruption(a: Interruption, b: Interruption): boolean {
583	  if (a.tool_use_id && b.tool_use_id) return a.tool_use_id === b.tool_use_id
584	  return a.at === b.at && a.code === b.code && (a.step ?? null) === (b.step ?? null)
585	}
586	
587	function nextSeq(steps: StepView[]): number {
588	  let max = -1
589	  for (const s of steps) for (const c of s.calls) if (c.seq > max) max = c.seq
590	  return max + 1
591	}
592	
593	/** Fold one event into the view state. Pure: never mutates `state`. */
594	export function reduce(state: ViewState, ev: Event): ViewState {
595	  if (!ev || typeof ev.type !== 'string') return state
596	  const data = asRecord(ev.data)
597	  const step = typeof ev.step === 'number' ? ev.step : state.step
598	  const next: ViewState = {
599	    ...state,
600	    runId: state.runId ?? str(ev.run_id),
601	    lastEventId: typeof ev.id === 'number' && ev.id > state.lastEventId ? ev.id : state.lastEventId,
602	    eventCount: state.eventCount + 1,
603	    step: Math.max(state.step, typeof ev.step === 'number' ? ev.step : 0),
604	  }
605	
606	  switch (ev.type) {
607	    case 'run.started': {
608	      next.status = 'running'
609	      next.scenarioId = str(data.scenario_id) ?? next.scenarioId
610	      next.model = str(data.model) ?? next.model
611	      next.seed = typeof data.seed === 'number' ? data.seed : next.seed
612	      next.maxSteps = num(data.max_steps, next.maxSteps)
613	      next.anthropicWorkspace = str(data.anthropic_workspace) ?? next.anthropicWorkspace
614	      next.startedAt = state.startedAt ?? str(ev.ts)
615	      return next
616	    }
617	
618	    case 'episode.reset': {
619	      next.episodeId = str(data.episode_id) ?? next.episodeId
620	      next.taskPrompt = str(data.task_prompt) ?? next.taskPrompt
621	      if (Array.isArray(data.files)) next.files = data.files as FileEntry[]
622	      if (next.status === 'queued') next.status = 'running'
623	      next.scenario = asScenario(data.scenario) ?? next.scenario
624	      const sandboxId = str(data.sandbox_id)
625	      if (sandboxId) {
626	        next.sandboxId = sandboxId
627	        next.sandboxAlive = true
628	      }
629	      if (typeof data.attempt === 'number') next.resetAttempt = data.attempt
630	      return next
631	    }
632	
633	    case 'turn.text': {
634	      const text = str(data.text)
635	      if (!text || text.trim().length === 0) return next
636	      const { steps, idx } = upsertStep(state.steps, step)
637	      const target = steps[idx]!
638	      const updated = [...steps]
639	      updated[idx] = { ...target, texts: [...target.texts, text] }
640	      next.steps = updated
641	      return next
642	    }
643	
644	    case 'turn.thinking': {
645	      const text = str(data.text)
646	      if (!text || text.trim().length === 0) return next
647	      const { steps, idx } = upsertStep(state.steps, step)
648	      const target = steps[idx]!
649	      const updated = [...steps]
650	      updated[idx] = { ...target, thinking: target.thinking ? `${target.thinking}\n\n${text}` : text }
651	      next.steps = updated
652	      return next
653	    }
654	
655	    case 'llm.call': {
656	      const view: LlmCallView = {
657	        step,
658	        attempt: Math.max(1, Math.trunc(num(data.attempt, 1))),
659	        model: str(data.model) ?? state.model ?? 'unknown',
660	        stopReason: str(data.stop_reason),
661	        usage: asUsage(data.usage),
662	        durationMs: typeof data.duration_ms === 'number' ? data.duration_ms : null,
663	        requestId: str(data.request_id),
664	        error: str(data.error),
665	      }
666	      // Same (step, attempt) twice means a replayed frame: replace rather than append.
667	      const i = state.llmCalls.findIndex((c) => c.step === view.step && c.attempt === view.attempt)
668	      const llmCalls = i >= 0 ? state.llmCalls.map((c, j) => (j === i ? view : c)) : [...state.llmCalls, view]
669	      next.llmCalls = llmCalls
670	      // `run.finished` (or a terminal record) is the authoritative total; before that, keep a
671	      // running sum so the header moves while the run is in flight.
672	      if (!isTerminal(state.status)) next.usage = sumLlmUsage(llmCalls)
673	      return next
674	    }
675	
676	    case 'tool.call': {
677	      const tool = str(data.tool) ?? 'unknown'
678	      const toolUseId = str(data.tool_use_id) ?? `${ev.id}`
679	      const input = asRecord(data.input)
680	      const { steps, idx } = upsertStep(state.steps, step)
681	      const target = steps[idx]!
682	      if (target.calls.some((c) => c.toolUseId === toolUseId)) {
683	        next.steps = steps
684	        return next
685	      }
686	      const cls = classify(tool, input)
687	      const call: ToolCallView = {
688	        seq: nextSeq(steps),
689	        step,
690	        toolUseId,
691	        tool,
692	        input,
693	        path: cls.path,
694	        command: cls.command,
695	        mutating: cls.mutating,
696	        read: cls.read,
697	        result: null,
698	        fault: null,
699	        recovered: false,
700	      }
701	      const updated = [...steps]
702	      updated[idx] = { ...target, calls: [...target.calls, call] }
703	      next.steps = applyRecovery(updated)
704	      return next
705	    }
706	
707	    case 'tool.result': {
708	      const toolUseId = str(data.tool_use_id)
709	      if (!toolUseId) return next
710	      const isError = data.is_error === true
711	      const result = parseToolResult(
712	        toolUseId,
713	        str(data.output) ?? '',
714	        isError,
715	        num(data.duration_ms, 0),
716	      )
717	      result.errorClass = isError ? asErrorClass(data.error_class) : null
718	      result.outcome = asToolOutcome(data.outcome)
719	      result.attempts = typeof data.attempts === 'number' ? Math.max(1, Math.trunc(data.attempts)) : null
720	      result.sandbox = asSandboxRef(data.sandbox)
721	      if (result.sandbox) {
722	        next.sandboxId = result.sandbox.id
723	        next.sandboxAlive = result.sandbox.alive
724	      }
725	      const fault = asFault(data.fault)
726	      let found = false
727	      const updated = state.steps.map((s) => {
728	        if (!s.calls.some((c) => c.toolUseId === toolUseId)) return s
729	        found = true
730	        return {
731	          ...s,
732	          calls: s.calls.map((c) =>
733	            c.toolUseId === toolUseId ? { ...c, result, fault: fault ?? c.fault } : c,

735	        }

747	          toolUseId,
748	          tool,
749	          input: {},
750	          path: cls.path,
751	          command: cls.command,
752	          mutating: cls.mutating,
753	          read: cls.read,
754	          result,
755	          fault,
756	          recovered: false,
757	        }
758	        const s2 = [...steps]
759	        s2[idx] = { ...target, calls: [...target.calls, synth] }

766	      next.steps = applyRecovery(updated)

770	    case 'fault.fired': {

775	      )
776	      next.faults = known ? state.faults : [...state.faults, fault]
777	      // Attach to the call at that step that touched the path and has no fault yet.
778	      const updated = state.steps.map((s) => {
779	        if (s.step !== fault.step) return s
780	        let attached = false
781	        const calls = s.calls.map((c) => {
782	          if (attached || c.fault) return c

793	    case 'workspace.diff': {

801	      next.evaluation = {
802	        episode_id: str(data.episode_id) ?? state.episodeId ?? '',
803	        score: num(data.score, 0),
804	        passed: data.passed === true,
805	        checks,
806	        tests: asRecord(data.tests) as unknown as EvaluateResponse['tests'],
807	        ledger: Array.isArray(data.ledger) ? (data.ledger as EvaluateResponse['ledger']) : [],

812	    case 'run.finished': {

818	      next.finishedAt = str(ev.ts) ?? state.finishedAt
819	      next.errorClass = asErrorClass(data.error_class) ?? state.errorClass
820	      const es = str(data.evaluation_status)

823	      return next

830	      next.interruptions = i >= 0 ? state.interruptions.map((x, j) => (j === i ? it : x)) : [...state.interruptions, it]

833	    }
834	
835	    case 'run.resumed': {
836	      const gen = Math.max(1, Math.trunc(num(data.worker_generation, state.workerGeneration + 1)))
837	      const resumed: RunResumedData = {
838	        worker_generation: gen,
839	        resumed_from_event_id: num(data.resumed_from_event_id, state.lastEventId),
840	        dangling_tool_use_id: str(data.dangling_tool_use_id),
841	        resumed_at: str(data.resumed_at) ?? str(ev.ts) ?? '',
842	      }
843	      const known = state.resumes.some((r) => r.worker_generation === gen)
844	      next.resumes = known ? state.resumes : [...state.resumes, resumed]
845	      next.workerGeneration = Math.max(state.workerGeneration, gen)
846	      // The interruption this resume answers (matched by the dangling call) is now `resumed`.
847	      const dangling = resumed.dangling_tool_use_id
848	      if (dangling) {

850	          x.tool_use_id === dangling && !x.resumed ? { ...x, resumed: true } : x,
851	        )
852	      }
853	      if (!isTerminal(state.status)) next.status = 'running'
854	      return next
855	    }
856	
857	    case 'episode.sandbox': {
858	      const sandboxId = str(data.sandbox_id)
859	      const status = str(data.status)
860	      if (!sandboxId || (status !== 'alive' && status !== 'terminated' && status !== 'replaced')) return next
861	      const notice: EpisodeSandboxData = {
862	        sandbox_id: sandboxId,
863	        status,
864	        reason: str(data.reason),
865	        step: typeof data.step === 'number' ? data.step : typeof ev.step === 'number' ? ev.step : null,
866	      }
867	      next.sandboxEvents = [...state.sandboxEvents, notice]
868	      next.sandboxId = sandboxId
869	      next.sandboxAlive = status === 'alive'
870	      return next
871	    }
872	
873	    case 'log': {
874	      const line = data as unknown as LogLine
875	      if (typeof line?.ev !== 'string') return next
876	      next.logs = [...state.logs, line].slice(-LOG_BUFFER_LIMIT)
877	      return next
878	    }
879	
880	    default:
881	      return next
882	  }
883	}
884	
885	export function reduceAll(events: Event[], from: ViewState = initialState()): ViewState {
886	  return events.reduce(reduce, from)
887	}
888	
889	/**
890	 * Seed the view from a whole RunRecord (page refresh mid-run, or a bundled demo). Record-level
891	 * fields win over anything the events implied, because the record is the harness's own summary.
892	 */
893	export function fromRunRecord(rec: RunRecord): ViewState {
894	  const folded = reduceAll(rec.events ?? [])
895	  // The record's usage is the harness's own running total and wins whenever it says anything.
896	  // The one exception is an in-flight record whose usage is still the {0,0} default while its
897	  // events already carry `llm.call` sums — showing zeros there would be a regression.
898	  const usage =
899	    rec.usage && (isTerminal(rec.status) || !usageIsEmpty(rec.usage) || usageIsEmpty(folded.usage))
900	      ? rec.usage
901	      : folded.usage
902	  return {
903	    ...folded,
904	    runId: rec.run_id ?? folded.runId,
905	    status: asRunStatus(rec.status) ?? folded.status,
906	    scenarioId: rec.scenario_id ?? folded.scenarioId,
907	    model: rec.model ?? folded.model,
908	    seed: rec.seed ?? folded.seed,
909	    maxSteps: rec.max_steps ?? folded.maxSteps,
910	    episodeId: rec.episode_id ?? folded.episodeId,
911	    taskPrompt: rec.task_prompt ?? folded.taskPrompt,
912	    startedAt: rec.created_at ?? folded.startedAt,
913	    finishedAt: rec.finished_at ?? folded.finishedAt,
914	    evaluation: rec.evaluation ?? folded.evaluation,
915	    usage,
916	    error: rec.error ?? folded.error,
917	    errorClass: rec.error_class ?? folded.errorClass,
918	    interruptions:
919	      Array.isArray(rec.interruptions) && rec.interruptions.length > 0 ? rec.interruptions : folded.interruptions,
920	    workerGeneration: Math.max(
921	      folded.workerGeneration,
922	      typeof rec.worker_generation === 'number' ? rec.worker_generation : 1,
923	    ),
924	  }
925	}
926	
927	// --------------------------------------------------------------------------- selectors
928	
929	export function allCalls(state: ViewState): ToolCallView[] {
930	  return flatten(state.steps)
931	}
932	
933	export function faultCount(state: ViewState): number {
934	  return allCalls(state).filter((c) => c.fault).length
935	}
936	
937	export function recoveredCount(state: ViewState): number {
938	  return allCalls(state).filter((c) => c.fault && c.recovered).length
939	}
940	
941	export function elapsedMs(state: ViewState, now: number = Date.now()): number | null {
942	  if (state.durationMs !== null) return state.durationMs
943	  if (!state.startedAt) return null
944	  const t0 = Date.parse(state.startedAt)
945	  if (Number.isNaN(t0)) return null
946	  const end = state.finishedAt ? Date.parse(state.finishedAt) : now
947	  return Math.max(0, (Number.isNaN(end) ? now : end) - t0)
948	}

1	/**
2	 * Plain-English tour of a run, one checkpoint per step, built ONLY from structured event fields
3	 * (tool names and inputs, is_error, fault / error_class / outcome, exit codes, the grader's
4	 * checks). Message text is never parsed; the agent's own prose is only quoted. Calls are
5	 * classified by the reducer's own `classifyCall` / `callTouches`, so "mutating" and "touches this
6	 * path" mean the same thing here as on the transcript.
7	 */
8	
9	import { checkText } from './checks'
10	import { codeText, taxonomyLabel } from './codes'
11	import { firstSentence } from './format'
12	import { callTouches, classifyCall, normalisePath, parseToolResult } from './reducer'
13	import type {
14	  ErrorClass,
15	  EvaluateResponse,
16	  Event,
17	  FaultFired,
18	  Scenario,
19	  ToolCallData,
20	  ToolResultData,
21	} from './types'
22	
23	export type StoryTone = 'info' | 'ok' | 'warn' | 'fail'
24	
25	export interface Checkpoint {
26	  /** How many events are folded into the view at this checkpoint. */
27	  index: number
28	  /** Harness step, or null for the prologue / epilogue. */
29	  step: number | null
30	  /** Short label for the scrubber ("Start", "Step 4", "Verdict"). */
31	  label: string
32	  title: string
33	  text: string
34	  tone: StoryTone
35	}
36	
37	export interface Story {
38	  checkpoints: Checkpoint[]
39	}
40	
41	interface CallFacts {
42	  toolUseId: string
43	  tool: string
44	  path: string | null
45	  command: string | null
46	  mutating: boolean
47	}
48	
49	function describeCall(c: CallFacts): string {
50	  switch (c.tool) {
51	    case 'write_file':
52	      return `wrote ${c.path ?? 'a file'}`
53	    case 'read_file':
54	      return `read ${c.path ?? 'a file'}`
55	    case 'list_dir':
56	      return `listed ${c.path && c.path !== '.' ? c.path : 'the workspace'}`
57	    case 'submit':
58	      return 'submitted its summary'
59	    case 'run_command':
60	      return c.command ? `ran \`${c.command.length > 72 ? `${c.command.slice(0, 69)}…` : c.command}\`` : 'ran a command'
61	    default:
62	      return `called ${c.tool}`
63	  }
64	}
65	
66	function callFacts(d: ToolCallData): CallFacts {
67	  const cls = classifyCall(String(d.tool), d.input ?? {})
68	  return { toolUseId: d.tool_use_id, tool: String(d.tool), path: cls.path, command: cls.command, mutating: cls.mutating }
69	}
70	
71	/** The exit code the tool reported, via the reducer's own result parser (structured JSON only). */
72	function exitCodeOf(r: ToolResultData): number | null {
73	  return parseToolResult(r.tool_use_id, r.output ?? '', r.is_error === true, r.duration_ms ?? 0).exitCode
74	}
75	
76	function isTestCommand(c: CallFacts): boolean {
77	  return !!c.command && /\bpytest\b/.test(c.command)
78	}
79	
80	function faultSentence(fault: FaultFired | null | undefined, ec: ErrorClass | null | undefined): { text: string; tone: StoryTone; unknown: boolean } | null {
81	  if (ec) {
82	    const label = ec.label
83	    const code = codeText(ec.code)
84	    if (ec.origin === 'real') {
85	      return {
86	        text: `This was a real failure, not a simulated one: ${label}.${ec.outcome_known === false ? ' Whether the operation ran is unknown.' : ''}`,
87	        tone: 'fail',
88	        unknown: ec.outcome_known === false,
89	      }
90	    }
91	    return {
92	      text: `The environment intercepted it: ${label}.${ec.outcome_known === false ? ' The agent cannot know whether the write landed.' : ''}${code ? ` (${code.plain})` : ''}`,
93	      tone: 'warn',
94	      unknown: ec.outcome_known === false,
95	    }
96	  }
97	  if (fault) {
98	    const label = taxonomyLabel(fault.origin ?? 'injected', fault.kind, fault.layer ?? null) ?? `simulated: ${fault.kind}`
99	    const unknown = fault.kind === 'ack_lost'
100	    return {
101	      text: `The environment intercepted it: ${label}.${unknown ? ' The agent cannot know whether the write landed.' : ''}`,
102	      tone: 'warn',
103	      unknown,
104	    }
105	  }
106	  return null
107	}
108	
109	function evaluationSentences(ev: EvaluateResponse): string[] {
110	  const out: string[] = []
111	  const t = ev.tests
112	  out.push(`The grader uploaded hidden tests into the sandbox and ran them: ${t.passed} passed, ${t.failed} failed${t.errors ? `, ${t.errors} errors` : ''}.`)
113	  const ok = ev.checks.filter((c) => c.ok)
114	  const bad = ev.checks.filter((c) => !c.ok)
115	  if (ev.checks.length) {
116	    out.push(`Recovery checks from the ledger: ${ok.length}/${ev.checks.length} passed${bad.length ? ` — failed: ${bad.map((c) => checkText(c.id).whenFailed).join('; ')}` : ''}.`)
117	  }
118	  out.push(`Score ${Math.round(ev.score)}/100.`)
119	  return out
120	}
121	
122	export function buildStory(events: Event[], scenario: Scenario | null): Story {
123	  const checkpoints: Checkpoint[] = []
124	  if (events.length === 0) return { checkpoints }
125	
126	  // ---------------------------------------------------------------- prologue
127	  let taskPrompt: string | null = null
128	  let model: string | null = null
129	  let firstStepIdx = events.findIndex((e) => typeof e.step === 'number' && e.step > 0 && e.type !== 'log')
130	  if (firstStepIdx < 0) firstStepIdx = events.length
131	  for (const e of events.slice(0, firstStepIdx)) {
132	    if (e.type === 'episode.reset' && typeof e.data.task_prompt === 'string') taskPrompt = e.data.task_prompt
133	    if (e.type === 'run.started' && typeof e.data.model === 'string') model = e.data.model
134	  }
135	  const injected = (scenario?.fault_kinds ?? []).map((k) => taxonomyLabel('injected', k, 'boundary') ?? `simulated: ${k}`)
136	  const real = scenario?.harness_faults ?? []
137	  const pro: string[] = []
138	  pro.push(taskPrompt ? `The task: ${firstSentence(taskPrompt, 220)}` : 'The agent is given a task in a sandboxed copy of a small Python repo.')
139	  if (model) pro.push(`The model is ${model}.`)
140	  if (injected.length) pro.push(`Somewhere along the way the environment will inject ${injected.length === 1 ? 'one failure' : `${injected.length} failures`}: ${injected.join('; ')}.`)
141	  if (real.length) pro.push(`It also includes a real harness interruption (${real.map((f) => f.kind.replace('_', ' ')).join(', ')}) — the worker really is killed.`)
142	  pro.push('The agent is not told any of this.')
143	  checkpoints.push({
144	    index: Math.max(firstStepIdx, 0),
145	    step: null,
146	    label: 'Start',
147	    title: scenario?.title ?? 'The task',
148	    text: pro.join(' '),
149	    tone: 'info',
150	  })
151	
152	  // ---------------------------------------------------------------- steps
153	  const stepOrder: number[] = []
154	  const byStep = new Map<number, Event[]>()
155	  for (const e of events) {
156	    if (typeof e.step !== 'number' || e.step <= 0 || e.type === 'log') continue
157	    if (!byStep.has(e.step)) {
158	      byStep.set(e.step, [])
159	      stepOrder.push(e.step)
160	    }
161	    byStep.get(e.step)!.push(e)
162	  }
163	  const lastIndexOfStep = new Map<number, number>()
164	  events.forEach((e, i) => {
165	    if (typeof e.step === 'number' && e.step > 0) lastIndexOfStep.set(e.step, i + 1)
166	  })
167	
168	  const calls = new Map<string, CallFacts>()
169	  /** paths whose last write ended with an unknown outcome and have not been read back since */
170	  const unverified = new Map<string, number>()
171	  const lastEvaluated = events.filter((e) => e.type === 'episode.evaluated').at(-1)
172	  const evaluation = lastEvaluated ? (lastEvaluated.data as unknown as EvaluateResponse) : null
173	
174	  for (const step of stepOrder) {
175	    const evs = byStep.get(step)!
176	    const sentences: string[] = []
177	    let tone: StoryTone = 'info'
178	    const prose = evs.find((e) => e.type === 'turn.text' && typeof e.data.text === 'string')
179	    if (prose) {
180	      const quote = firstSentence(String(prose.data.text), 160)
181	      if (quote) sentences.push(`The agent: “${quote}”`)
182	    }
183	    const stepCalls = evs.filter((e) => e.type === 'tool.call').map((e) => callFacts(e.data as unknown as ToolCallData))
184	    for (const c of stepCalls) calls.set(c.toolUseId, c)
185	    const results = evs.filter((e) => e.type === 'tool.result').map((e) => e.data as unknown as ToolResultData)
186	    const faultsFired = evs.filter((e) => e.type === 'fault.fired').map((e) => e.data as unknown as FaultFired)
187	
188	    const actions: string[] = []
189	    for (const c of stepCalls) {
190	      const r = results.find((x) => x.tool_use_id === c.toolUseId)
191	      let s = `It ${describeCall(c)}`
192	      if (r) {
193	        const ec = r.error_class ?? null
194	        const fault =
195	          r.fault ?? faultsFired.find((f) => f.step === step && (!c.path || normalisePath(f.path) === c.path)) ?? null
196	        const exit = exitCodeOf(r)
197	        if (r.is_error) {
198	          const fs = faultSentence(fault, ec)
199	          if (fs) {
200	            s += `. ${fs.text}`
201	            tone = fs.tone === 'fail' ? 'fail' : tone === 'fail' ? 'fail' : 'warn'
202	            // The path whose write is now in doubt: the call's own, else the one the fault names.
203	            const doubted = c.path ?? (fault?.path ? normalisePath(fault.path) : null)
204	            if (fs.unknown && doubted) unverified.set(doubted, step)
205	          } else {
206	            s += '. It failed — the record carries no classification, so what happened is unknown.'
207	            tone = tone === 'fail' ? 'fail' : 'warn'
208	          }
209	        } else if (exit !== null && exit !== 0) {
210	          // A test command's exit status is a fact; whether "the tests failed" is the grader's call.
211	          s += ` — ${isTestCommand(c) ? 'the test command' : 'it'} exited ${exit}.`
212	          tone = tone === 'info' ? 'warn' : tone
213	        } else if (exit === 0 && isTestCommand(c)) {
214	          s += ' — the test command exited 0.'
215	          tone = tone === 'info' ? 'ok' : tone
216	        } else {
217	          s += '.'
218	        }
219	        // recovery observations (derived from call order, not from text)
220	        if (!r.is_error) {
221	          const doubted = [...unverified.keys()].find((p) => callTouches(c, p))
222	          if (doubted) {
223	            if (!c.mutating) {
224	              s += ` That read-back is the right move after a lost acknowledgement: now it knows the file's real contents.`
225	              unverified.delete(doubted)
226	              tone = tone === 'fail' ? 'fail' : 'ok'
227	            } else {
228	              s += ` It wrote ${doubted} again without reading it back — if the first write landed, this duplicates it.`
229	              tone = 'warn'
230	            }
231	          }
232	        }
233	      } else {
234	        s += ' (no result recorded).'
235	      }
236	      actions.push(s)
237	    }
238	    sentences.push(...actions)
239	    if (stepCalls.length === 0 && !prose) sentences.push('Nothing observable happened in this step.')
240	
241	    checkpoints.push({
242	      index: lastIndexOfStep.get(step) ?? events.length,
243	      step,
244	      label: `Step ${step}`,
245	      title: `Step ${step}`,
246	      text: sentences.join(' '),
247	      tone,
248	    })
249	  }
250	
251	  // ---------------------------------------------------------------- epilogue
252	  const finished = events.filter((e) => e.type === 'run.finished').at(-1)
253	  const status = finished ? String(finished.data.status ?? '') : ''
254	  const epi: string[] = []
255	  let epiTone: StoryTone = 'info'
256	  if (evaluation) {
257	    epi.push(...evaluationSentences(evaluation))
258	    epiTone = evaluation.passed && evaluation.checks.every((c) => c.ok) ? 'ok' : 'warn'
259	  }
260	  if (status && status !== 'ok') {
261	    const ec = (finished?.data.error_class as ErrorClass | undefined) ?? null
262	    epi.push(`The run ended ${status}${ec ? `: ${ec.label}` : typeof finished?.data.error === 'string' ? `: ${firstSentence(String(finished.data.error), 140)}` : ''}.`)
263	    epiTone = status === 'truncated' ? 'warn' : 'fail'
264	  }
265	  if (!evaluation && !status) epi.push('The run has not been graded.')
266	  checkpoints.push({
267	    index: events.length,
268	    step: null,
269	    label: 'Verdict',
270	    title: evaluation ? `Verdict: ${Math.round(evaluation.score)}/100` : 'Verdict',
271	    text: epi.join(' '),
272	    tone: epiTone,
273	  })
274	
275	  return { checkpoints }
276	}
277	
278	/** The checkpoint the cursor is currently inside (the last one whose index <= cursor). */
279	export function checkpointAt(story: Story, cursor: number): number {
280	  let idx = 0
281	  story.checkpoints.forEach((c, i) => {
282	    if (c.index <= cursor) idx = i
283	  })
284	  return idx
285	}

13	/** The tour guide: what happened at the current checkpoint, in plain English, with prev/next. */
14	export function StoryBar({

18	  onPrev,
19	  onNext,
20	}: {

22	  position: number
23	  total: number
24	  onPrev: () => void
25	  onNext: () => void
26	}) {
27	  if (!checkpoint) return null
28	  const tone = TONE[checkpoint.tone]
29	  return (
30	    <div
31	      // Fixed height so the transcript below never jumps as narrations change length;
32	      // a long checkpoint scrolls inside its own box instead of growing the bar.
33	      className={`h-[108px] shrink-0 border-b bg-card/40 ${tone.ring}`}
34	      role="region"

42	          className="h-7 w-7 shrink-0 self-center p-0"

56	            key={`${checkpoint.index}-${checkpoint.title}`}

14	const SOURCE_LABEL: Record<TranscriptSource, { label: string; tip: string; icon: typeof Radio }> = {

16	  poll: { label: 'live · poll', tip: 'SSE failed twice in a row — polling GET /runs/{id} every 1.5 s instead.', icon: Radio },
17	  sqlite: { label: 'sqlite', tip: 'Transcript loaded from GET /conversations/{id}: the messages/blocks projection stored in SQLite on the persistent volume.', icon: Database },
18	  record: { label: 'record', tip: 'Loaded from GET /runs/{id} (the persisted run record).', icon: Database },

21	function Stat({ label, value, title }: { label: string; value: string; title?: string }) {
22	  return (
23	    <div className="hidden flex-col leading-tight lg:flex" title={title}>
24	      <span className="text-[10px] tracking-wide text-muted-foreground uppercase">{label}</span>
25	      <span className="font-mono text-[11px] tabular-nums">{value}</span>
26	    </div>
27	  )
28	}

30	export function RunStatusStrip({
31	  state,
32	  transport,
33	  source,
34	}: {
35	  state: ViewState | null
36	  transport: TransportState | null
37	  source: TranscriptSource | null
38	}) {
39	  const live = !!state && (state.status === 'running' || state.status === 'queued')
40	  const [, setTick] = useState(0)
41	  useEffect(() => {
42	    if (!live) return
43	    const t = setInterval(() => setTick((n) => n + 1), 1000)
44	    return () => clearInterval(t)
45	  }, [live])
46	
47	  if (!state) return null
48	  const faults = faultCount(state)
49	  const recovered = recoveredCount(state)
50	  const grade = gradeOf(state.evaluation)
51	  const checks = state.evaluation?.checks ?? []
52	  const okChecks = checks.filter((c) => c.ok).length
53	  const src = source ? SOURCE_LABEL[source] : null
54	  const SrcIcon = src?.icon ?? Radio
55	
56	  return (
57	    <div className="flex items-center gap-2.5">
58	      <Badge
59	        variant="outline"
60	        className={`font-mono ${statusTone(state.status, grade)}`}
61	        title={statusTitle(state.status, grade)}
62	        data-grade={state.status === 'ok' ? grade : undefined}
63	      >
64	        {state.status}
65	      </Badge>
66	      {src ? (
67	        <Tooltip>
68	          <TooltipTrigger
69	            render={

71	                <SrcIcon aria-hidden /> {src.label}
72	              </Badge>
73	            }
74	          />
75	          <TooltipContent>{src.tip}{transport?.detail ? ` (${transport.detail})` : ''}</TooltipContent>
76	        </Tooltip>
77	      ) : null}
78	      <Stat label="step" value={`${state.step}/${state.maxSteps}`} />
79	      <Stat
80	        label="tokens"
81	        value={`${fmtTokens(state.usage.input_tokens)} in · ${fmtTokens(state.usage.output_tokens)} out`}
82	        title={`${state.usage.input_tokens} input / ${state.usage.output_tokens} output`}
83	      />
84	      <Stat label="elapsed" value={fmtDuration(elapsedMs(state))} />
85	      <Stat label="faults" value={`${faults}`} title="Faults the environment fired on this run's tool calls" />
86	      {state.evaluation ? (
87	        <Stat
88	          label="checks"
89	          value={`${okChecks}/${checks.length} passed`}
90	          title="The grader's checks (authoritative)"
91	        />
92	      ) : (
93	        <Stat
94	          label="read-back"
95	          value={`${recovered}/${faults} seen`}
96	          title="Live hint from the call order (a read of the faulted path before a later success); heuristic — the grader's checks are authoritative"
97	        />
98	      )}
99	      {state.evaluation ? <Stat label="score" value={`${Math.round(state.evaluation.score)}`} /> : null}
100	    </div>
101	  )
102	}

1	/**
2	 * Source-independent transcript view model.
3	 *
4	 * The UI renders one shape whether the run is streaming (ViewState from the reducer), being
5	 * replayed from a bundled RunRecord (also ViewState), or read back from the harness Store as
6	 * Anthropic-shaped messages (ConversationDetail.messages). The persisted path re-uses the
7	 * reducer's own classification, result parsing and recovery derivation, so a fault badge or a
8	 * "read-back seen" hint means the same thing on every path. That hint is a heuristic from call
9	 * order; the grader's checks (`evaluation`) are authoritative and the UI prefers them once they
10	 * exist. The messages projection carries no evaluation or run error of its own — the caller
11	 * overlays them from the run record (`transcriptFromMessages(messages, run, overlay)`).
12	 */
13	
14	import {
15	  applyRecovery,
16	  classifyCall,
17	  isTerminal,
18	  parseToolResult,
19	  type StepView,
20	  type ToolCallView,
21	  type ViewState,
22	} from './reducer'
23	import type { Block, EvaluateResponse, Message, RunStatus, RunSummary } from './types'
24	
25	export interface Turn {
26	  step: number
27	  thinking: string | null
28	  texts: string[]
29	  calls: ToolCallView[]
30	}
31	
32	export interface Transcript {
33	  runId: string | null
34	  status: RunStatus
35	  scenarioId: string | null
36	  model: string | null
37	  taskPrompt: string | null
38	  turns: Turn[]
39	  evaluation: EvaluateResponse | null
40	  score: number | null
41	  /** The run's error text (`run.finished.error` / `RunRecord.error`); RunSummary carries none. */
42	  error: string | null
43	  /** True while more turns may still arrive. */
44	  live: boolean
45	}
46	
47	/** Record-level fields the messages projection does not carry (from `GET /runs/{id}`). */
48	export interface TranscriptOverlay {
49	  evaluation?: EvaluateResponse | null
50	  error?: string | null
51	  status?: RunStatus | null
52	}
53	
54	export function transcriptFromViewState(state: ViewState, live: boolean): Transcript {
55	  return {
56	    runId: state.runId,
57	    status: state.status,
58	    scenarioId: state.scenarioId,
59	    model: state.model,
60	    taskPrompt: state.taskPrompt,
61	    turns: state.steps.map((s) => ({ step: s.step, thinking: s.thinking, texts: s.texts, calls: s.calls })),
62	    evaluation: state.evaluation,
63	    score: state.evaluation?.score ?? null,
64	    error: state.error,
65	    live,
66	  }
67	}
68	
69	function sortedBlocks(m: Message): Block[] {
70	  return [...(m.blocks ?? [])].sort((a, b) => a.seq - b.seq)
71	}
72	
73	function upsertTurn(turns: StepView[], step: number): StepView {
74	  const found = turns.find((t) => t.step === step)
75	  if (found) return found
76	  const fresh: StepView = { step, thinking: null, texts: [], calls: [] }
77	  turns.push(fresh)
78	  turns.sort((a, b) => a.step - b.step)
79	  return fresh
80	}
81	
82	function highestStep(turns: StepView[]): number {
83	  return turns.reduce((m, t) => Math.max(m, t.step), 0)
84	}
85	
86	function nextSeq(turns: StepView[]): number {
87	  let max = -1
88	  for (const t of turns) for (const c of t.calls) if (c.seq > max) max = c.seq
89	  return max + 1
90	}
91	
92	function makeCall(turns: StepView[], step: number, toolUseId: string, tool: string, input: Record<string, unknown>): ToolCallView {
93	  const cls = classifyCall(tool, input)
94	  return {
95	    seq: nextSeq(turns),
96	    step,
97	    toolUseId,
98	    tool,
99	    input,
100	    path: cls.path,
101	    command: cls.command,
102	    mutating: cls.mutating,
103	    read: cls.read,
104	    result: null,
105	    fault: null,
106	    recovered: false,
107	  }
108	}
109	
110	function findCall(turns: StepView[], toolUseId: string): { turn: StepView; idx: number } | null {
111	  for (const turn of turns) {
112	    const idx = turn.calls.findIndex((c) => c.toolUseId === toolUseId)
113	    if (idx >= 0) return { turn, idx }
114	  }
115	  return null
116	}
117	
118	function attachResult(turns: StepView[], msg: Message, b: Block): void {
119	  const toolUseId = b.tool_use_id
120	  if (!toolUseId) return
121	  const result = parseToolResult(toolUseId, b.text ?? '', b.is_error === true, b.duration_ms ?? 0)
122	  if (result.exitCode === null && typeof b.exit_code === 'number') result.exitCode = b.exit_code
123	  if (b.truncated) result.truncated = true
124	  const fault = b.fault ?? null
125	
126	  const hit = findCall(turns, toolUseId)
127	  if (hit) {
128	    const prev = hit.turn.calls[hit.idx]!
129	    hit.turn.calls[hit.idx] = { ...prev, result, fault: fault ?? prev.fault }
130	    return
131	  }
132	  const step = typeof msg.step === 'number' ? msg.step : highestStep(turns)
133	  const turn = upsertTurn(turns, step)
134	  const synth = makeCall(turns, step, toolUseId, b.tool_name ?? 'unknown', {})
135	  turn.calls.push({ ...synth, result, fault })
136	}
137	
138	/**
139	 * Build the transcript of one run from a conversation's persisted messages.
140	 *
141	 * Grouping follows ARCHITECTURE.md §4.5: the first user message's text block is the task prompt;
142	 * each assistant message is one turn (thinking / text / tool_use blocks in seq order); the user
143	 * message that follows carries the tool_result blocks, matched back by tool_use_id.
144	 *
145	 * `overlay` supplies what the projection lacks: the grader's evaluation, the run error and the
146	 * record's status. Without it the transcript has no evaluation — which the UI must render as
147	 * "not graded", never as a pass.
148	 */
149	export function transcriptFromMessages(
150	  messages: Message[],
151	  run: RunSummary,
152	  overlay: TranscriptOverlay = {},
153	): Transcript {
154	  const mine = messages.filter((m) => m.run_id === run.id).sort((a, b) => a.seq - b.seq)
155	
156	  let taskPrompt: string | null = null
157	  const turns: StepView[] = []
158	
159	  for (const m of mine) {
160	    const blocks = sortedBlocks(m)
161	
162	    if (m.role === 'user') {
163	      for (const b of blocks) {
164	        if (b.type === 'tool_result') {
165	          attachResult(turns, m, b)
166	        } else if (b.type === 'text' && taskPrompt === null && typeof b.text === 'string' && b.text.length > 0) {
167	          taskPrompt = b.text
168	        }
169	      }
170	      continue
171	    }
172	
173	    const step = typeof m.step === 'number' ? m.step : highestStep(turns)
174	    const turn = upsertTurn(turns, step)
175	    for (const b of blocks) {
176	      switch (b.type) {
177	        case 'thinking': {
178	          const text = b.text ?? ''
179	          if (text.trim().length === 0) break
180	          turn.thinking = turn.thinking ? `${turn.thinking}\n\n${text}` : text
181	          break
182	        }
183	        case 'text': {
184	          const text = b.text ?? ''
185	          if (text.trim().length === 0) break
186	          turn.texts.push(text)
187	          break
188	        }
189	        case 'tool_use': {
190	          const toolUseId = b.tool_use_id ?? b.id
191	          if (turn.calls.some((c) => c.toolUseId === toolUseId)) break
192	          const input = b.input && typeof b.input === 'object' ? b.input : {}
193	          turn.calls.push(makeCall(turns, step, toolUseId, b.tool_name ?? 'unknown', input))
194	          break
195	        }
196	        default:
197	          break
198	      }
199	    }
200	  }
201	
202	  const recovered = applyRecovery(turns)
203	  const evaluation = overlay.evaluation ?? null
204	  const status = overlay.status ?? run.status
205	
206	  return {
207	    runId: run.id,
208	    status,
209	    scenarioId: run.scenario_id,

61	const PILL_TONE: Record<CallStatusTone, string> = {

64	  error: 'bg-rose-500/10 text-rose-700 dark:text-rose-300 ring-rose-500/30',
