59	export function resultParts(result: ToolResultView, path: string | null): ResultPart[] {
60	  const parts: ResultPart[] = []
61	  if (result.errorText) parts.push({ label: result.errorCode ?? 'error', body: result.errorText, tone: 'error' })
62	  if (result.stdout) parts.push({ label: 'stdout', body: result.stdout, tone: 'plain' })
63	  if (result.stderr) parts.push({ label: 'stderr', body: result.stderr, tone: 'plain' })
64	  if (result.content !== null) {
65	    parts.push({ label: 'content', body: result.content, tone: 'plain', code: { filename: path } })
66	  }
67	  if (result.entries) {
68	    parts.push({

73	  }
74	  if (result.bytesWritten !== null) {
75	    parts.push({ label: 'write', body: `${result.bytesWritten} bytes written`, tone: 'plain' })
76	  }
77	  if (parts.length === 0 && result.output) parts.push({ label: 'output', body: result.output, tone: 'plain' })
78	  return parts
79	}

3	 *

6	 * evaluation: green when every test and check passed, amber when something failed, neutral when

11	
12	export type Grade = 'passed' | 'partial' | 'ungraded'
13	
14	/**
15	 * `score = 60 × tests_pass + 40 × weighted checks` (services/sandbox-env/GRADING.md), so a score
16	 * of 100 means every test and every check passed and anything less means one of them failed. With
17	 * the full evaluation at hand the checks themselves decide.
18	 */
19	export function gradeOf(evaluation: EvaluateResponse | null | undefined, score?: number | null): Grade {
20	  if (evaluation) {
21	    return evaluation.passed && (evaluation.checks ?? []).every((c) => c.ok) ? 'passed' : 'partial'
22	  }
23	  if (typeof score === 'number' && Number.isFinite(score)) return score >= 100 ? 'passed' : 'partial'
24	  return 'ungraded'
25	}

28	  queued: 'border-border text-muted-foreground',

31	  truncated: 'border-amber-500/30 bg-amber-500/10 text-amber-700 dark:text-amber-300',
32	  // the loop finished but evaluate failed — not the agent's fault (docs/error-taxonomy.md)
33	  unevaluated: 'border-violet-500/30 bg-violet-500/10 text-violet-700 dark:text-violet-300',
34	  // a real interruption ended the run and no worker resumed it

1	/**
2	 * One status per tool call, derived ONLY from structured fields — `outcome`, `error_class`, the
3	 * fault that fired, `is_error` and the exit code — never from the error text.
4	 *
5	 * "Unknown" is its own state. A lost acknowledgement, a transport failure or a harness interruption
6	 * means the call may or may not have run (docs/error-taxonomy.md, `outcome_known: false`).
7	 * Rendering that as a failure would tell the reader the write did not land — the one thing nobody
8	 * knows yet. Likewise a call the environment answered without executing (an injected
9	 * `missing_file` / `denied_write` short-circuit) is "not executed", not "failed".
10	 */
11	
12	import type { ToolCallView } from './reducer'
13	import type { FaultFired, ToolOutcome } from './types'
14	
15	export type CallStatusKind = 'running' | 'pending' | 'ok' | 'failed' | 'unknown' | 'not_executed'
16	export type CallStatusTone = 'ok' | 'error' | 'unknown' | 'muted'
17	
18	export interface CallStatus {
19	  kind: CallStatusKind
20	  /** Short pill text: "exit 0", "error", "no ack", "not executed", … */
21	  label: string
22	  tone: CallStatusTone
23	  /** One or two sentences for a tooltip. */
24	  detail: string
25	  /** `data-status` value for tests and styling. */
26	  attr: 'running' | 'pending' | 'ok' | 'error' | 'unknown' | 'not-executed'
27	}
28	
29	/**
30	 * The harness's `outcome` when it sent one; otherwise what the structured error class or the fault
31	 * that fired implies (FAULTS.md: `ack_lost` always leaves the outcome unknown to the agent; an
32	 * injected `missing_file` / `denied_write` never reaches the sandbox). Null when nothing structured
33	 * says anything — the caller then falls back to `is_error` and the exit code.
34	 */
35	export function effectiveOutcome(
36	  result: NonNullable<ToolCallView['result']>,
37	  fault: FaultFired | null,
38	): ToolOutcome | null {
39	  if (result.outcome) return result.outcome
40	  const ec = result.errorClass
41	  if (ec && ec.outcome_known === false) return 'unknown'
42	  if (fault) {
43	    const origin = fault.origin ?? 'injected'
44	    if (fault.kind === 'ack_lost') return 'unknown'
45	    if (origin === 'injected' && (fault.kind === 'missing_file' || fault.kind === 'denied_write')) {
46	      return 'not_executed'
47	    }
48	  }
49	  return null
50	}
51	
52	export function callStatus(call: Pick<ToolCallView, 'result' | 'fault'>, live = false): CallStatus {
53	  const r = call.result
54	  if (!r) {
55	    return live
56	      ? { kind: 'running', label: 'running', tone: 'muted', detail: 'Waiting for the result.', attr: 'running' }
57	      : { kind: 'pending', label: 'no result', tone: 'muted', detail: 'No result was recorded for this call.', attr: 'pending' }
58	  }
59	  const ec = r.errorClass
60	  const outcome = effectiveOutcome(r, call.fault)
61	  const exit = r.exitCode
62	
63	  if (outcome === 'unknown') {
64	    const ackLost = call.fault?.kind === 'ack_lost'
65	    const landed =
66	      ec?.side_effect_applied === true
67	        ? ' The ledger later confirmed it had landed.'
68	        : ec?.side_effect_applied === false
69	          ? ' The ledger later confirmed it had not run.'
70	          : ackLost
71	            ? ' (The environment withheld the acknowledgement on purpose; the call did run.)'
72	            : ''
73	    return {
74	      kind: 'unknown',
75	      label: ackLost ? 'no ack' : 'unknown',
76	      tone: 'unknown',
77	      detail: `The response never arrived, so the agent cannot know whether this call ran. Reading the state back before retrying is the right move.${landed}`,
78	      attr: 'unknown',
79	    }
80	  }
81	
82	  if (outcome === 'not_executed') {
83	    const real = ec?.origin === 'real'
84	    return {
85	      kind: 'not_executed',
86	      label: 'not executed',
87	      tone: real ? 'error' : 'unknown',
88	      detail: real
89	        ? 'Refused before it reached the sandbox (a real error at the tool boundary); nothing ran.'
90	        : 'Answered by the environment without running (an injected fault); nothing on disk changed.',
91	      attr: 'not-executed',
92	    }
93	  }
94	
95	  const failed = outcome === 'failed' || r.isError || (exit !== null && exit !== 0)
96	  if (failed) {
97	    return {
98	      kind: 'failed',
99	      label: exit !== null ? `exit ${exit}` : 'error',
100	      tone: 'error',
101	      detail:
102	        ec?.origin === 'real'
103	          ? 'A real failure: the sandbox ran it (or tried to) and reported an error.'
104	          : exit !== null
105	            ? `The command ran and exited ${exit}.`
106	            : 'The call ran and reported an error.',
107	      attr: 'error',
108	    }
109	  }
110	  return {
111	    kind: 'ok',
112	    label: exit !== null ? `exit ${exit}` : 'ok',
113	    tone: 'ok',
114	    detail: exit !== null ? `The command ran and exited ${exit}.` : 'The call ran and succeeded.',
115	    attr: 'ok',
116	  }
117	}

2	 * Owns one run's view state and its transport: GET /runs/{id} to seed (so a page refresh mid-run
3	 * restores everything), then subscribeRun() for the tail.
4	 *
5	 * The seed is best-effort in one direction only: a run created a moment ago can 5xx or time out
6	 * until the harness has written it, and then the tail must still start. A 404 is different — the
7	 * harness answers 404 both for an unknown run and for one that belongs to another browser identity
8	 * (no existence oracle) — so it is reported as `notFound` and no tail is opened.
9	 *
10	 * State is keyed by the source, so switching runs resets by derivation rather than by setState
11	 * inside the effect.
12	 */
13	
14	import { useCallback, useEffect, useRef, useState } from 'react'
15	
16	import { HarnessClient, isNotFound, subscribeRun, type Subscription, type TransportState } from '@/lib/api'
17	import { getLogger } from '@/lib/log'

19	import type { Event, RunRecord } from '@/lib/types'
20	
21	const log = getLogger('web')

23	export type RunSource = { kind: 'none' } | { kind: 'live'; runId: string }
24	
25	export interface RunViewState {
26	  state: ViewState
27	  transport: TransportState | null

29	  loadError: string | null
30	  loading: boolean
31	  /** GET /runs/{id} answered 404: unknown run, or one owned by another browser identity. */
32	  notFound: boolean

45	}
46	
47	function emptySlot(key: string): Slot {
48	  return {
49	    key,
50	    state: initialState(),
51	    transport: null,
52	    loadError: null,
53	    loading: key !== 'none',
54	    notFound: false,
55	    record: null,
56	  }
57	}

63	export function useRunView(client: HarnessClient | null, source: RunSource): RunViewState {

76	  const push = useCallback(
77	    (forKey: string, events: Event[]) => {
78	      patch(forKey, (s) => ({ ...s, state: events.reduce(reduce, s.state) }))
79	    },
80	    [patch],
81	  )
82	
83	  useEffect(() => {
84	    let cancelled = false
85	    const stop = () => {
86	      cancelled = true
87	      subRef.current?.close()
88	      subRef.current = null
89	    }
90	
91	    if (key === 'none') return stop
92	
93	    const runId = key.slice('live:'.length)
94	    if (!client) return stop // reported as "harness URL not resolved yet" by derivation below
95	
96	    void (async () => {
97	      let from = -1
98	      try {
99	        const rec = await client.getRun(runId)
100	        if (cancelled) return
101	        patch(key, (s) => ({ ...s, state: fromRunRecord(rec), record: rec, loadError: null, notFound: false }))
102	        from = rec.events?.length ? Math.max(...rec.events.map((e) => e.id)) : -1
103	        log.info('run.restored', 'seeded view from GET /runs/{id}', {
104	          run_id: runId,
105	          events: rec.events?.length ?? 0,
106	          status: rec.status,
107	        })
108	      } catch (err) {
109	        if (cancelled) return
110	        if (isNotFound(err)) {
111	          patch(key, (s) => ({ ...s, loading: false, notFound: true, loadError: null }))
112	          log.warn('run.not_found', 'GET /runs/{id} is 404 for this identity; not tailing', { run_id: runId })
113	          return
114	        }
115	        patch(key, (s) => ({ ...s, loadError: String(err) }))
116	        log.warn('run.load_error', 'GET /runs failed; relying on the stream', {
117	          run_id: runId,
118	          error: String(err),
119	        })
120	      }
121	      if (cancelled) return
122	      patch(key, (s) => ({ ...s, loading: false }))
123	      subRef.current = subscribeRun({
124	        base: client.base,
125	        runId,
126	        lastEventId: from,
127	        headers: client.headers(),
128	        onEvents: (events) => {
129	          if (!cancelled) push(key, events)
130	        },
131	        onRecord: (r) => {
132	          if (cancelled) return
133	          // The polling fallback returns the whole record; take the summary fields from it so the
134	          // header stays right even if a `run.finished` event was missed.
135	          patch(key, (s) => ({
136	            ...s,
137	            record: r,
138	            state: {
139	              ...s.state,
140	              status: r.status ?? s.state.status,
141	              usage: r.usage ?? s.state.usage,
142	              evaluation: r.evaluation ?? s.state.evaluation,
143	              error: r.error ?? s.state.error,
144	              finishedAt: r.finished_at ?? s.state.finishedAt,
145	            },
146	          }))
147	        },
148	        onTransport: (t) => {
149	          if (!cancelled) patch(key, (s) => ({ ...s, transport: t }))
150	        },
151	      })
152	    })()
153	
154	    return stop
155	  }, [key, client, patch, push])
156	
157	  const current = slot && slot.key === key ? slot : emptySlot(key)
158	  const noClient = key !== 'none' && client === null
159	  return {
160	    state: current.state,
161	    transport: current.transport,
162	    loadError: noClient ? 'harness URL not resolved yet' : current.loadError,
163	    loading: noClient ? false : current.loading,
164	    notFound: current.notFound,
165	    record: current.record,
166	  }
167	}

1	/**
2	 * Resolve the harness URL once, build the client for the current identity, then keep the two
3	 * things Home needs from it: `/health` and `/scenarios`.
4	 *
5	 * Both are allowed to fail. A dead harness must still leave a usable page — the bundled replay
6	 * is the whole reason demo mode exists — so failures land in `healthError` / `scenariosError`
7	 * rather than throwing.
8	 */
9	
10	import { useCallback, useEffect, useMemo, useState } from 'react'
11	
12	import { useIdentity } from '@/hooks/useIdentity'
13	import { HarnessClient } from '@/lib/api'
14	import { resolveConfig, type ResolvedConfig } from '@/lib/config'
15	import { getLogger } from '@/lib/log'
16	import type { Health, Scenario } from '@/lib/types'
17	
18	const log = getLogger('web')
19	
20	const NO_URL_ERROR = 'harness URL not configured (config.json or VITE_HARNESS_URL); replays still work'
21	
22	/**
23	 * Three states, not two: a cold harness answers `/health` in ~12 s, and during that window the
24	 * UI must say "checking", not "unreachable".
25	 */
26	export type HealthPhase = 'resolving' | 'checking' | 'reachable' | 'unreachable'
27	
28	export function healthPhase(hasClient: boolean, health: Health | null, healthError: string | null): HealthPhase {
29	  if (health?.ok === true) return 'reachable'
30	  if (healthError !== null) return 'unreachable'
31	  if (health !== null) return 'unreachable' // answered, but not ok
32	  return hasClient ? 'checking' : 'resolving'
33	}
34	
35	export interface HarnessState {
36	  /** Resolved harness origin, or null while resolving. */
37	  base: string | null
38	  /** `/health` answered and reported ok — the only gate on starting a live run. */
39	  reachable: boolean
40	  /** resolving → checking → reachable | unreachable. */
41	  phase: HealthPhase
42	  /** Where the URL came from: window | config.json | build-env | default. */
43	  source: ResolvedConfig['source'] | null
44	  health: Health | null
45	  healthError: string | null
46	  scenarios: Scenario[]
47	  scenariosError: string | null
48	  loading: boolean
49	  refresh: () => void
50	  /** Bound to the current identity: every request carries `X-Faultline-User`. Null until the URL resolves. */
51	  client: HarnessClient | null
52	  /** The anonymous browser id the client sends. */
53	  userId: string
54	}
55	
56	interface Probe<T> {
57	  client: HarnessClient
58	  epoch: number
59	  value: T | null
60	  error: string | null
61	}
62	
63	export function useHarness(): HarnessState {
64	  const { userId } = useIdentity()
65	  const [cfg, setCfg] = useState<ResolvedConfig | null>(null)
66	  /** Last answers, keyed by the (client, refresh epoch) that produced them; stale keys read as "not yet". */
67	  const [healthProbe, setHealthProbe] = useState<Probe<Health> | null>(null)
68	  const [scenariosProbe, setScenariosProbe] = useState<Probe<Scenario[]> | null>(null)
69	  const [nonce, setNonce] = useState(0)
70	
71	  // 1. Resolve the base URL once.
72	  useEffect(() => {
73	    let cancelled = false
74	    void resolveConfig().then((resolved) => {
75	      if (cancelled) return
76	      setCfg(resolved)
77	      log.info('config.resolved', 'harness URL resolved', {
78	        harness_url: resolved.harnessUrl,
79	        source: resolved.source,
80	      })
81	      if (!resolved.harnessUrl) log.warn('config.missing', 'no harness URL configured; live runs disabled')
82	    })
83	    return () => {
84	      cancelled = true
85	    }
86	  }, [])
87	
88	  // 2. One client per (base, identity). A reset() of the id rebuilds it.
89	  const client = useMemo(
90	    () => (cfg && cfg.harnessUrl ? new HarnessClient(cfg.harnessUrl, { userId }) : null),
91	    [cfg, userId],
92	  )
93	
94	  // 3. Probe /health and /scenarios whenever the client changes or refresh() is called.
95	  useEffect(() => {
96	    if (!client) return
97	    let cancelled = false
98	
99	    // Deliberately NOT `await Promise.all*` before updating: a cold harness answers /health in
100	    // ~12 s while /scenarios comes back in 0.3 s (or the other way round). Coupling them would
101	    // leave the whole page on a spinner for the slower of the two, so each settles on its own.
102	    client
103	      .health()
104	      .then((value) => {
105	        if (cancelled) return
106	        setHealthProbe({ client, epoch: nonce, value, error: null })
107	        log.info('health.ok', 'harness reachable', {
108	          model_default: value.model_default ?? null,
109	          has_provider_key: value.has_provider_key,
110	        })
111	      })
112	      .catch((err: unknown) => {
113	        if (cancelled) return
114	        setHealthProbe({ client, epoch: nonce, value: null, error: String(err) })
115	        log.warn('health.error', 'harness unreachable', { error: String(err) })
116	      })
117	
118	    client
119	      .scenarios()
120	      .then((value) => {
121	        if (cancelled) return
122	        setScenariosProbe({ client, epoch: nonce, value, error: null })
123	        log.info('scenarios.loaded', 'catalogue loaded', { count: value.length })
124	      })
125	      .catch((err: unknown) => {
126	        if (cancelled) return
127	        setScenariosProbe({ client, epoch: nonce, value: null, error: String(err) })
128	        log.warn('scenarios.error', 'GET /scenarios failed', { error: String(err) })
129	      })
130	
131	    return () => {
132	      cancelled = true
133	    }
134	  }, [client, nonce])
135	
136	  const refresh = useCallback(() => setNonce((n) => n + 1), [])
137	
138	  // 2b. No URL at all (no /config.json, no VITE_HARNESS_URL): say so instead of spinning forever.
139	  const noUrl = !!cfg && !cfg.harnessUrl
140	  const healthCurrent = !!client && !!healthProbe && healthProbe.client === client && healthProbe.epoch === nonce
141	  const scenariosCurrent =
142	    !!client && !!scenariosProbe && scenariosProbe.client === client && scenariosProbe.epoch === nonce
143	
144	  const health = healthCurrent ? healthProbe.value : null
145	  const healthError = noUrl ? NO_URL_ERROR : healthCurrent ? healthProbe.error : null
146	  const scenarios = scenariosCurrent ? (scenariosProbe.value ?? []) : []
147	  const scenariosError = scenariosCurrent ? scenariosProbe.error : null
148	
149	  // Loading until the URL resolves, and again whenever the client or the refresh epoch moves on.
150	  const loading = !cfg || (client !== null && !(healthCurrent && scenariosCurrent))
151	
152	  return {
153	    base: cfg?.harnessUrl ?? null,
154	    reachable: health?.ok === true,
155	    phase: healthPhase(client !== null, health, healthError),
156	    source: cfg?.source ?? null,
157	    health,
158	    healthError,
159	    scenarios,
160	    scenariosError,
161	    loading,
162	    refresh,
163	    client,
164	    userId,
165	  }
166	}

1	/**
2	 * Typed harness client: plain cross-origin JSON fetches plus a resilient run subscription.
3	 *
4	 * Reliability model (this is the interesting part):
5	 *  - The harness closes every SSE stream at ~110 s to stay under the hosting platform's 150 s request cap, so a
6	 *    clean close mid-run is NORMAL and must not be treated as a failure. The server announces it
7	 *    with `event: done` + `{reason:"window"}`; an older harness just closes, and we distinguish
8	 *    that from a real failure by whether the stream delivered anything first.
9	 *  - EventSource cannot set headers, so the resume point is passed both natively (the browser
10	 *    sends `Last-Event-ID` on its own reconnect) and as a `last_event_id` query param on ours.
11	 *    For the same reason the SSE request carries no `X-Faultline-User`; ownership is enforced on
12	 *    the JSON routes, and a run id is unguessable.
13	 *  - After two consecutive failed opens we stop trusting SSE and fall back to polling
14	 *    GET /runs/{id} every 1.5 s, which is strictly less efficient but works through anything.
15	 *  - No credentials are ever sent: the web origin and the harness origin are different
16	 *    subdomains and these are ordinary CORS requests. Identity travels as a header instead
17	 *    (ARCHITECTURE.md §6).
18	 */
19	
20	import { getLogger } from './log'
21	import type {
22	  ArchiveResponse,
23	  Conversation,
24	  ConversationDetail,
25	  ConversationRunRequest,
26	  ConversationRunResponse,
27	  ConversationSummary,
28	  CreateConversationRequest,
29	  CreateRunResponse,
30	  Event,
31	  EventType,
32	  Health,
33	  MeResponse,
34	  RunRecord,
35	  RunRequest,
36	  RunStatus,
37	  Scenario,
38	  UpdateConversationRequest,
39	} from './types'
40	import { isTerminal } from './reducer'
41	
42	const log = getLogger('web')
43	
44	export const USER_HEADER = 'X-Faultline-User'
45	
46	const EVENT_TYPES: EventType[] = [
47	  'run.started',
48	  'episode.reset',
49	  'turn.text',
50	  'tool.call',
51	  'tool.result',
52	  'fault.fired',
53	  'workspace.diff',
54	  'episode.evaluated',
55	  'run.finished',
56	  'log',
57	  'llm.call',
58	  'turn.thinking',
59	  'interruption',
60	  'run.resumed',
61	  'episode.sandbox',
62	]
63	
64	export class HarnessError extends Error {
65	  constructor(
66	    message: string,
67	    readonly status?: number,
68	    readonly url?: string,
69	  ) {
70	    super(message)
71	    this.name = 'HarnessError'
72	  }
73	}
74	
75	/** True for a HarnessError carrying HTTP 404 — the harness's "not yours / not there". */
76	export function isNotFound(err: unknown): boolean {
77	  return err instanceof HarnessError && err.status === 404
78	}
79	
80	type HeaderMap = Record<string, string>
81	
82	function toHeaderMap(h: HeadersInit | undefined): HeaderMap {
83	  if (!h) return {}
84	  if (Array.isArray(h)) return Object.fromEntries(h)
85	  if (typeof Headers !== 'undefined' && h instanceof Headers) {
86	    const out: HeaderMap = {}
87	    h.forEach((v, k) => {
88	      out[k] = v
89	    })
90	    return out
91	  }
92	  return { ...(h as HeaderMap) }
93	}
94	
95	async function jsonFetch<T>(
96	  url: string,
97	  init: RequestInit = {},
98	  fetchImpl: typeof fetch = fetch,
99	  headers: HeaderMap = {},
100	): Promise<T> {
101	  const t0 = Date.now()
102	  let res: Response
103	  try {
104	    res = await fetchImpl(url, {
105	      ...init,
106	      credentials: 'omit',
107	      headers: { accept: 'application/json', ...headers, ...toHeaderMap(init.headers) },
108	    })
109	  } catch (err) {
110	    log.error('http.error', 'request failed', { url, error: String(err) })
111	    throw new HarnessError(`network error contacting ${url}: ${String(err)}`, undefined, url)
112	  }
113	  const durMs = Date.now() - t0
114	  if (!res.ok) {
115	    const body = await res.text().catch(() => '')
116	    // 404 is an expected answer for routes a harness build may not have yet (/me, /conversations).
117	    log[res.status === 404 ? 'warn' : 'error']('http.response', 'non-2xx', {
118	      url,
119	      status: res.status,
120	      dur_ms: durMs,
121	    })
122	    throw new HarnessError(
123	      `${res.status} ${res.statusText} from ${url}${body ? `: ${body.slice(0, 400)}` : ''}`,
124	      res.status,
125	      url,
126	    )
127	  }
128	  log.debug('http.response', 'ok', { url, status: res.status, dur_ms: durMs })
129	  return (await res.json()) as T
130	}
131	
132	/**
133	 * PLAN.md 2.3 specifies `GET /scenarios -> [Scenario]`, but the deployed harness answers
134	 * `{"scenarios": [...]}`. Rather than break on either, accept both shapes here — this is the one
135	 * place in the app that has to know, and a client that tolerates an envelope costs nothing.
136	 * Logged as a contract deviation.
137	 */
138	export function normaliseScenarios(body: unknown): Scenario[] {
139	  if (Array.isArray(body)) return body as Scenario[]
140	  if (body && typeof body === 'object') {
141	    const inner = (body as { scenarios?: unknown }).scenarios
142	    if (Array.isArray(inner)) {
143	      log.debug('scenarios.envelope', 'harness returned {scenarios: [...]}, unwrapping', {
144	        count: inner.length,
145	      })
146	      return inner as Scenario[]
147	    }
148	  }
149	  log.warn('scenarios.shape', 'unrecognised /scenarios payload; treating as empty', {
150	    got: typeof body,
151	  })
152	  return []
153	}
154	
155	/** Same tolerance as normaliseScenarios, for any list route: bare array or `{<key>: [...]}`. */
156	function normaliseList<T>(body: unknown, key: string): T[] {
157	  if (Array.isArray(body)) return body as T[]
158	  if (body && typeof body === 'object') {
159	    const inner = (body as Record<string, unknown>)[key]
160	    if (Array.isArray(inner)) {
161	      log.debug(`${key}.envelope`, `harness returned {${key}: [...]}, unwrapping`, { count: inner.length })
162	      return inner as T[]
163	    }
164	  }
165	  log.warn(`${key}.shape`, `unrecognised /${key} payload; treating as empty`, { got: typeof body })
166	  return []
167	}
168	
169	export interface HarnessClientOptions {
170	  /** Anonymous browser id (identity.ts). Sent as `X-Faultline-User` on every request when set. */
171	  userId?: string | null
172	  fetchImpl?: typeof fetch
173	}
174	
175	export class HarnessClient {
176	  readonly base: string
177	  readonly userId: string | null
178	  private readonly fetchImpl: typeof fetch
179	
180	  /**
181	   * `new HarnessClient(base, { userId, fetchImpl })`. The older positional form
182	   * `new HarnessClient(base, fetchImpl)` is still accepted.
183	   */
184	  constructor(base: string, opts: HarnessClientOptions | typeof fetch = {}) {
185	    this.base = base
186	    if (typeof opts === 'function') {
187	      this.fetchImpl = opts
188	      this.userId = null
189	    } else {
190	      this.fetchImpl = opts.fetchImpl ?? fetch
191	      this.userId = opts.userId ?? null
192	    }
193	  }
194	
195	  /** Headers every JSON request carries (identity). Also used by the polling fallback. */
196	  headers(): HeaderMap {
197	    return this.userId ? { [USER_HEADER]: this.userId } : {}
198	  }
199	
200	  private get<T>(path: string, signal?: AbortSignal): Promise<T> {
201	    return jsonFetch<T>(`${this.base}${path}`, { signal }, this.fetchImpl, this.headers())
202	  }
203	
204	  private send<T>(method: 'POST' | 'PATCH' | 'DELETE', path: string, body?: unknown, signal?: AbortSignal): Promise<T> {
205	    return jsonFetch<T>(
206	      `${this.base}${path}`,
207	      {
208	        method,
209	        ...(body === undefined
210	          ? {}
211	          : { headers: { 'content-type': 'application/json' }, body: JSON.stringify(body) }),
212	        signal,
213	      },
214	      this.fetchImpl,
215	      this.headers(),
216	    )
217	  }
218	
219	  // ---------------------------------------------------------------- health / catalogue
220	
221	  health(signal?: AbortSignal): Promise<Health> {
222	    return this.get<Health>('/health', signal)
223	  }
224	
225	  async scenarios(signal?: AbortSignal): Promise<Scenario[]> {
226	    const body = await this.get<Scenario[] | { scenarios?: Scenario[] }>('/scenarios', signal)
227	    return normaliseScenarios(body)
228	  }
229	
230	  // ---------------------------------------------------------------- runs
231	
232	  createRun(req: RunRequest, signal?: AbortSignal): Promise<CreateRunResponse> {
233	    log.info('run.create', 'POST /runs', {
234	      scenario_id: req.scenario_id,
235	      model: req.model ?? null,
236	    })
237	    return this.send<CreateRunResponse>('POST', '/runs', req, signal)
238	  }
239	
240	  getRun(runId: string, signal?: AbortSignal): Promise<RunRecord> {
241	    return this.get<RunRecord>(`/runs/${encodeURIComponent(runId)}`, signal)
242	  }
243	
244	  // ---------------------------------------------------------------- identity / conversations
245	  // The harness answers 404 both for an unknown id and for one owned by another browser identity
246	  // (no existence oracle); callers use isNotFound() to say "not found", never to fall back.
247	
248	  me(signal?: AbortSignal): Promise<MeResponse> {
249	    return this.get<MeResponse>('/me', signal)
250	  }
251	
252	  async listConversations(signal?: AbortSignal): Promise<ConversationSummary[]> {
253	    const body = await this.get<ConversationSummary[] | { conversations?: ConversationSummary[] }>(
254	      '/conversations',
255	      signal,
256	    )
257	    return normaliseList(body, 'conversations')
258	  }
259	
260	  getConversation(id: string, signal?: AbortSignal): Promise<ConversationDetail> {
261	    return this.get<ConversationDetail>(`/conversations/${encodeURIComponent(id)}`, signal)
262	  }
263	
264	  createConversation(req: CreateConversationRequest, signal?: AbortSignal): Promise<Conversation> {
265	    log.info('conversation.create', 'POST /conversations', { scenario_id: req.scenario_id })
266	    return this.send<Conversation>('POST', '/conversations', req, signal)
267	  }
268	
269	  createConversationRun(
270	    id: string,
271	    req: ConversationRunRequest,
272	    signal?: AbortSignal,
273	  ): Promise<ConversationRunResponse> {
274	    log.info('conversation.run', 'POST /conversations/{id}/runs', {
275	      conversation_id: id,
276	      model: req.model ?? null,
277	    })
278	    return this.send<ConversationRunResponse>(
279	      'POST',
280	      `/conversations/${encodeURIComponent(id)}/runs`,
281	      req,
282	      signal,
283	    )
284	  }
285	
286	  updateConversation(
287	    id: string,
288	    patch: UpdateConversationRequest,
289	    signal?: AbortSignal,
290	  ): Promise<Conversation> {
291	    return this.send<Conversation>('PATCH', `/conversations/${encodeURIComponent(id)}`, patch, signal)
292	  }

294	  /** Soft archive (the harness never hard-deletes). */
295	  archiveConversation(id: string, signal?: AbortSignal): Promise<ArchiveResponse> {
296	    log.info('conversation.archive', 'DELETE /conversations/{id}', { conversation_id: id })
297	    return this.send<ArchiveResponse>('DELETE', `/conversations/${encodeURIComponent(id)}`, undefined, signal)

301	// ------------------------------------------------------------------ run subscription
302	
303	export type TransportMode = 'sse' | 'poll' | 'closed'
304	
305	export interface TransportState {
306	  mode: TransportMode
307	  /** Consecutive failed SSE opens. Reset whenever a stream delivers an event. */
308	  errors: number
309	  detail?: string
310	}
311	
312	export interface SubscribeOptions {
313	  base: string
314	  runId: string
315	  /** Resume point; -1 means "from the beginning". */
316	  lastEventId?: number
317	  onEvents: (events: Event[]) => void
318	  onRecord?: (record: RunRecord) => void
319	  onTransport?: (state: TransportState) => void
320	  onDone?: () => void
321	  /** Extra headers for the polling fetch (identity). EventSource cannot carry them. */
322	  headers?: Record<string, string>
323	  /** Injection points for tests. */
324	  eventSourceImpl?: typeof EventSource | null
325	  fetchImpl?: typeof fetch

327	  reconnectDelayMs?: number
328	  maxSseErrors?: number
329	  setTimeoutImpl?: (fn: () => void, ms: number) => unknown
330	  clearTimeoutImpl?: (handle: unknown) => void
331	}
332	
333	export interface Subscription {
334	  close: () => void
335	  /** Test/debug introspection. */
336	  state: () => TransportState
337	}
338	
339	function parseEvent(raw: string): Event | null {
340	  try {
341	    const v = JSON.parse(raw) as Event
342	    return typeof v?.id === 'number' && typeof v?.type === 'string' ? v : null
343	  } catch {
344	    return null
345	  }
346	}
347	
348	/** Payload of the server's `event: done` frame. Older harness builds send no data at all. */
349	export interface DonePayload {
350	  reason?: 'finished' | 'window' | string
351	  status?: RunStatus | string | null
352	  last_event_id?: number
353	  run_id?: string
354	}
355	
356	export function parseDone(raw: unknown): DonePayload | null {
357	  if (typeof raw !== 'string' || raw.length === 0) return null
358	  try {
359	    const v = JSON.parse(raw) as unknown
360	    return v !== null && typeof v === 'object' && !Array.isArray(v) ? (v as DonePayload) : null
361	  } catch {
362	    return null
363	  }
364	}
365	
366	/**
367	 * Does this `done` frame end the run, or merely the current ~110 s window?
368	 * Only an explicit `reason: "window"` with a non-terminal status means "reconnect"; anything
369	 * ambiguous (no data, unparseable, unknown reason, terminal status) is treated as finished, which
370	 * is the safe default — a wrongly-ended subscription can be re-opened, a wrongly-kept one spins.
371	 */
372	export function doneMeansReconnect(payload: DonePayload | null): boolean {
373	  if (!payload) return false
374	  if (payload.reason !== 'window') return false
375	  return !isTerminal((payload.status ?? null) as RunStatus | null)
376	}
377	
378	/**
379	 * Tail a run. Returns immediately; every update arrives through the callbacks.
380	 * Always call `close()` — it tears down the EventSource and any pending timer.
381	 */
382	export function subscribeRun(opts: SubscribeOptions): Subscription {
383	  const {
384	    base,
385	    runId,
386	    onEvents,
387	    onRecord,
388	    onTransport,
389	    onDone,
390	    headers = {},
391	    fetchImpl = typeof fetch !== 'undefined' ? fetch : undefined,
392	    pollIntervalMs = 1500,
393	    reconnectDelayMs = 1000,
394	    maxSseErrors = 2,
395	    setTimeoutImpl = (fn, ms) => setTimeout(fn, ms),
396	    clearTimeoutImpl = (h) => clearTimeout(h as ReturnType<typeof setTimeout>),
397	  } = opts
398	
399	  const ESImpl =
400	    opts.eventSourceImpl !== undefined
401	      ? opts.eventSourceImpl
402	      : typeof EventSource !== 'undefined'
403	        ? EventSource
404	        : null
405	
406	  let lastEventId = opts.lastEventId ?? -1
407	  let closed = false
408	  let es: EventSource | null = null
409	  let timer: unknown = null
410	  let transport: TransportState = { mode: 'sse', errors: 0 }
411	
412	  const setTransport = (patch: Partial<TransportState>) => {
413	    transport = { ...transport, ...patch }
414	    onTransport?.(transport)
415	  }
416	
417	  const clearTimer = () => {
418	    if (timer !== null) {
419	      clearTimeoutImpl(timer)
420	      timer = null
421	    }
422	  }
423	
424	  const emit = (events: Event[]) => {
425	    const fresh = events.filter((e) => e.id > lastEventId)
426	    if (fresh.length === 0) return
427	    lastEventId = Math.max(lastEventId, ...fresh.map((e) => e.id))
428	    onEvents(fresh)
429	  }
430	
431	  const finish = (reason: string) => {
432	    if (closed) return
433	    log.info('stream.done', reason, { run_id: runId, last_event_id: lastEventId })
434	    closed = true
435	    es?.close()
436	    es = null
437	    clearTimer()
438	    setTransport({ mode: 'closed', detail: reason })
439	    onDone?.()
440	  }
441	
442	  // ------------------------------------------------ polling fallback
443	
444	  const pollOnce = async () => {
445	    if (closed || !fetchImpl) return
446	    try {
447	      const rec = await jsonFetch<RunRecord>(
448	        `${base}/runs/${encodeURIComponent(runId)}`,
449	        {},
450	        fetchImpl,
451	        headers,
452	      )
453	      onRecord?.(rec)
454	      emit(rec.events ?? [])
455	      if (isTerminal(rec.status)) {
456	        finish('run reached a terminal status (poll)')
457	        return
458	      }
459	    } catch (err) {
460	      log.warn('poll.error', 'GET /runs failed', { run_id: runId, error: String(err) })
461	      setTransport({ detail: String(err) })
462	    }
463	    if (!closed) timer = setTimeoutImpl(() => void pollOnce(), pollIntervalMs)
464	  }
465	
466	  const startPolling = (why: string) => {
467	    if (closed) return
468	    es?.close()
469	    es = null
470	    clearTimer()
471	    log.warn('stream.fallback', `switching to polling: ${why}`, {
472	      run_id: runId,
473	      interval_ms: pollIntervalMs,
474	    })
475	    setTransport({ mode: 'poll', detail: why })
476	    void pollOnce()
477	  }
478	
479	  // ------------------------------------------------ SSE
480	
481	  const openSse = () => {
482	    if (closed || !ESImpl) return
483	    const url = new URL(`${base}/runs/${encodeURIComponent(runId)}/events`)
484	    if (lastEventId >= 0) url.searchParams.set('last_event_id', String(lastEventId))
485	    let deliveredThisStream = 0
486	
487	    log.info('stream.open', 'opening SSE', { run_id: runId, url: url.toString() })
488	    const source = new ESImpl(url.toString())
489	    es = source
490	
491	    /** Drop this stream and open a fresh one at the resume point; the error counter stays 0. */
492	    const rotate = (why: string) => {
493	      source.close()
494	      if (es === source) es = null
495	      log.info('stream.rotate', why, {
496	        run_id: runId,
497	        delivered: deliveredThisStream,
498	        last_event_id: lastEventId,
499	      })
500	      setTransport({ errors: 0 })
501	      timer = setTimeoutImpl(openSse, 0)
502	    }
503	
504	    const handle = (e: MessageEvent) => {
505	      const ev = parseEvent(e.data as string)
506	      if (!ev) {
507	        log.warn('stream.parse_error', 'unparseable SSE frame', { run_id: runId })
508	        return
509	      }
510	      deliveredThisStream += 1
511	      if (transport.errors !== 0) setTransport({ errors: 0, detail: undefined })
512	      emit([ev])
513	      if (ev.type === 'run.finished') {
514	        // Let the server send `done`; if it does not, the close handler below stops us.
515	        log.info('stream.run_finished', 'run.finished seen', { run_id: runId })
516	      }
517	    }
518	
519	    source.addEventListener('message', handle as EventListener)
520	    for (const t of EVENT_TYPES) source.addEventListener(t, handle as EventListener)
521	    source.addEventListener('done', ((e: MessageEvent) => {
522	      if (closed) return
523	      const payload = parseDone(e?.data)
524	      if (doneMeansReconnect(payload)) {
525	        rotate('server closed its ~110 s window (`done` reason=window); reconnecting')
526	        return
527	      }
528	      finish(
529	        payload?.reason
530	          ? `server sent \`event: done\` (reason=${payload.reason}, status=${String(payload.status ?? '?')})`
531	          : 'server sent `event: done`',
532	      )
533	    }) as EventListener)
534	
535	    source.addEventListener('open', () => {
536	      log.info('stream.connected', 'SSE open', { run_id: runId })
537	      setTransport({ mode: 'sse' })
538	    })
539	
540	    source.addEventListener('error', () => {
541	      if (closed) return
542	      if (es !== source) return // already rotated away from this stream
543	      if (deliveredThisStream > 0) {
544	        // Expected on an older harness: the stream closes at ~110 s with no `done` frame.
545	        rotate('stream closed after delivering events; reconnecting')
546	        return
547	      }
548	      source.close()
549	      es = null
550	      const errors = transport.errors + 1
551	      setTransport({ errors, detail: 'EventSource error' })
552	      log.warn('stream.error', 'SSE failed before delivering anything', {
553	        run_id: runId,
554	        errors,
555	      })
556	      if (errors >= maxSseErrors) {
557	        startPolling(`${errors} consecutive EventSource errors`)
558	        return
559	      }
560	      timer = setTimeoutImpl(openSse, reconnectDelayMs)
561	    })
562	  }
563	
564	  if (ESImpl) {
565	    openSse()
566	  } else {
567	    startPolling('EventSource unavailable in this environment')
568	  }
569	
570	  return {
571	    close: () => {
572	      if (closed) return
573	      closed = true
574	      es?.close()
575	      es = null
576	      clearTimer()
577	      setTransport({ mode: 'closed', detail: 'closed by caller' })
578	      log.info('stream.close', 'subscription closed by caller', { run_id: runId })
579	    },
580	    state: () => transport,
581	  }
582	}

1	/**
2	 * Path-based routes with no router dependency.
3	 *
4	 *   /                         home
5	 *   /conversations/:id[?run=] a persisted conversation, optionally focused on one of its runs
6	 *   /runs/:id                 a bare run (a run id without its conversation context)
7	 *   /replay/:demoId           a bundled replay, no backend
8	 *
9	 * Anything else is home. hrefFor() emits exactly these forms; serve.py answers unknown
10	 * extension-less paths with index.html, so deep links survive a refresh.
11	 *
12	 * Navigation is pushState/replaceState plus a custom event, so every useRoute() instance and any
13	 * plain listener re-reads the location; the browser's own popstate (back/forward) is honoured too.
14	 */
15	
16	import { useSyncExternalStore } from 'react'
17	
18	import { getLogger } from './log'
19	
20	const log = getLogger('web')
21	
22	export type Route =
23	  | { kind: 'home' }
24	  | { kind: 'conversation'; id: string; runId?: string | null }
25	  | { kind: 'run'; runId: string }
26	  | { kind: 'replay'; demoId: string }
27	
28	/** Dispatched on `window` after every in-app navigation (in addition to the native `popstate`). */
29	export const ROUTE_EVENT = 'faultline:route'
30	
31	const HOME: Route = { kind: 'home' }
32	
33	function decode(s: string): string {
34	  try {
35	    return decodeURIComponent(s)
36	  } catch {
37	    return s
38	  }
39	}
40	
41	function segments(pathname: string): string[] {
42	  return pathname.split('/').filter((s) => s.length > 0).map(decode)
43	}
44	
45	function params(search: string): URLSearchParams {
46	  return new URLSearchParams(search.startsWith('?') ? search.slice(1) : search)
47	}
48	
49	export function parseRoute(pathname: string, search = ''): Route {
50	  const segs = segments(pathname || '/')
51	  const q = params(search)
52	
53	  if (segs.length === 0) return HOME
54	
55	  if (segs.length === 2) {
56	    const [head, id] = segs as [string, string]
57	    if (id.length === 0) return HOME
58	    if (head === 'conversations') return { kind: 'conversation', id, runId: q.get('run') || null }
59	    if (head === 'runs') return { kind: 'run', runId: id }
60	    if (head === 'replay') return { kind: 'replay', demoId: id }
61	  }
62	
63	  return HOME
64	}
65	
66	export function hrefFor(route: Route): string {
67	  switch (route.kind) {
68	    case 'home':
69	      return '/'
70	    case 'conversation': {
71	      const base = `/conversations/${encodeURIComponent(route.id)}`
72	      return route.runId ? `${base}?run=${encodeURIComponent(route.runId)}` : base
73	    }
74	    case 'run':
75	      return `/runs/${encodeURIComponent(route.runId)}`
76	    case 'replay':
77	      return `/replay/${encodeURIComponent(route.demoId)}`
78	  }
79	}
80	
81	/** Structural equality, so callers can skip no-op navigations. */
82	export function sameRoute(a: Route, b: Route): boolean {
83	  return hrefFor(a) === hrefFor(b)
84	}
85	
86	// --------------------------------------------------------------------------- window binding
87	
88	function locationKey(): string {
89	  return `${window.location.pathname}${window.location.search}`
90	}
91	
92	/** The route the address bar currently shows. */
93	export function currentRoute(): Route {
94	  if (typeof window === 'undefined') return HOME
95	  return parseRoute(window.location.pathname, window.location.search)
96	}
97	
98	export interface NavigateOptions {
99	  /** Replace the current history entry instead of pushing a new one. */
100	  replace?: boolean
101	}
102	
103	export function navigate(route: Route, opts: NavigateOptions = {}): void {
104	  if (typeof window === 'undefined') return
105	  const href = hrefFor(route)
106	  // Pushing an entry identical to the current one only makes Back a no-op; replace instead.
107	  const replace = opts.replace === true || href === locationKey()
108	  try {
109	    if (replace) window.history.replaceState({}, '', href)
110	    else window.history.pushState({}, '', href)
111	  } catch (err) {
112	    // history can throw in sandboxed/srcdoc frames; the in-memory route still updates below.
113	    log.warn('route.history_error', 'history update failed', { href, error: String(err) })
114	  }
115	  log.info('route.change', replace ? 'replaced' : 'navigated', { href, kind: route.kind })
116	  window.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent<Route>(ROUTE_EVENT, { detail: route }))
117	}
118	
119	/** Fires on back/forward and after navigate(). */
120	export function subscribeRoute(fn: () => void): () => void {
121	  if (typeof window === 'undefined') return () => {}
122	  window.addEventListener('popstate', fn)
123	  window.addEventListener(ROUTE_EVENT, fn)
124	  return () => {
125	    window.removeEventListener('popstate', fn)
126	    window.removeEventListener(ROUTE_EVENT, fn)
127	  }
128	}
129	
130	// Snapshot must be referentially stable for an unchanged location, or useSyncExternalStore
131	// would re-render forever.
132	let cache: { key: string; route: Route } | null = null
133	
134	function getSnapshot(): Route {
135	  const key = locationKey()
136	  if (cache && cache.key === key) return cache.route
137	  cache = { key, route: parseRoute(window.location.pathname, window.location.search) }
138	  return cache.route
139	}
140	
141	function getServerSnapshot(): Route {
142	  return HOME
143	}
144	
145	/** The current Route; re-renders on navigate() and on the browser's back/forward. */
146	export function useRoute(): Route {
147	  return useSyncExternalStore(subscribeRoute, getSnapshot, getServerSnapshot)
148	}

1	/** Small presentation helpers. No React, no side effects — safe to unit test. */
2	
3	import type { ErrorOrigin, FaultKind } from './types'
4	
5	export function fmtDuration(ms: number | null | undefined): string {
6	  if (ms === null || ms === undefined || !Number.isFinite(ms)) return '—'
7	  if (ms < 1000) return `${Math.round(ms)} ms`
8	  const s = ms / 1000
9	  if (s < 60) return `${s.toFixed(s < 10 ? 1 : 0)} s`
10	  const m = Math.floor(s / 60)
11	  const rem = Math.round(s % 60)
12	  return `${m}m ${String(rem).padStart(2, '0')}s`
13	}
14	
15	export function fmtBytes(n: number | null | undefined): string {
16	  if (n === null || n === undefined || !Number.isFinite(n)) return '—'
17	  if (n < 1024) return `${n} B`
18	  if (n < 1024 * 1024) return `${(n / 1024).toFixed(1)} KB`
19	  return `${(n / (1024 * 1024)).toFixed(1)} MB`
20	}
21	
22	export function fmtTokens(n: number): string {
23	  if (n < 1000) return String(n)
24	  return `${(n / 1000).toFixed(1)}k`
25	}
26	
27	/** One-line preview of a command or path for a collapsed card header. */
28	export function oneLine(s: string, max = 120): string {
29	  const flat = s.replace(/\s+/g, ' ').trim()
30	  return flat.length <= max ? flat : `${flat.slice(0, max - 1)}…`
31	}

37	export const FAULT_KIND_BLURB: Record<FaultKind, string> = {
38	  missing_file:
39	    'Reads of one path are answered with ENOENT. Transient: intercepted at the tool boundary while the file stays on disk. Sticky: the file is left out of the workspace at reset, so the error is genuine until the agent recreates it.',
40	  denied_write:
41	    'The first writes to one path are refused with EACCES at the tool boundary; nothing is written until the fault lifts.',
42	  ack_lost:
43	    'A write runs for real, then the environment withholds the response. The agent cannot know the write landed.',
44	}

46	/**
47	 * What really happened for one fault that fired, by kind and origin. The injected and staged
48	 * variants of `missing_file` are different worlds: the injected file is still on disk, the staged
49	 * one really is absent.
50	 */
51	export function faultBlurb(kind: FaultKind | string, origin: ErrorOrigin = 'injected'): string {
52	  switch (kind) {
53	    case 'missing_file':
54	      return origin === 'staged'
55	        ? 'The file was left out of the workspace at reset, so this ENOENT is a genuine OS error: the file really is absent until the agent recreates it.'
56	        : 'A read was answered with ENOENT at the tool boundary; the file was on disk the whole time and is served normally once the fault lifts.'
57	    case 'denied_write':

59	    case 'ack_lost':

61	    default:

63	  }

66	/** First 7 hex chars of a sha256, for a file-list column. */

71	/**
72	 * The first sentence of a prompt, for a one-line summary. Breaks on `.`, `!` or `?` followed by
73	 * whitespace (optionally after a closing quote/bracket/backtick), so "0.2.0" and "README.md:" do
74	 * not end the sentence. Capped at `max` chars with an ellipsis.
75	 */
76	export function firstSentence(s: string | null | undefined, max = 240): string {
77	  if (!s) return ''
78	  const flat = s.replace(/\s+/g, ' ').trim()
79	  const m = /[.!?][`'")\]]*(?=\s)/.exec(flat)

102	  denied_write: 'simulated: write denied (nothing written)',

104	}
105	
106	const STAGED_LABEL: Partial<Record<FaultKind, string>> = {
107	  missing_file: 'staged: file absent since reset',
108	}
109	
110	/** Fixed labels the taxonomy prescribes for real failures, by layer. */
111	const REAL_LABEL: Record<ErrorLayer, string> = {
112	  filesystem: 'real: OS error in sandbox',
113	  sandbox: 'real: sandbox terminated or unavailable',
114	  transport: 'real: transport failure harness<->sandbox-env (outcome unknown)',
115	  harness: 'real: harness worker interrupted mid-call (outcome unknown)',
116	  model: 'real: model API error',
117	  gym: 'real: gym control-plane failure',
118	  boundary: 'real: internal error in sandbox-env',
119	}
120	
121	/**
122	 * The taxonomy's own (origin, kind) / (origin, layer) → label table, for records that carry the
123	 * provenance fields but no `label` (e.g. a `fault.fired` without an `error_class`). Returns null
124	 * when the table has no row — never guesses.
125	 */
126	export function taxonomyLabel(
127	  origin: ErrorOrigin | 'unknown' | null | undefined,
128	  kind: FaultKind | string | null | undefined,
129	  layer: ErrorLayer | null | undefined,
130	): string | null {
131	  if (origin === 'injected') return (kind && INJECTED_LABEL[kind as FaultKind]) ?? null
132	  if (origin === 'staged') return (kind && STAGED_LABEL[kind as FaultKind]) ?? null
133	  if (origin === 'real') return (layer && REAL_LABEL[layer]) ?? null
134	  return null
135	}

35	    ? null

37	      ? null
38	      : current.step !== null
39	        ? current.step
40	        : at === 0
41	          ? 'start'
42	          : 'end'
43	
44	  const goTo = (i: number) => {
45	    const cp = story.checkpoints[Math.max(0, Math.min(i, story.checkpoints.length - 1))]
46	    if (cp) rp.setCursor(cp.index)

48	
49	  return (

62	            cursor={rp.cursor}

4	import { fromRunRecord, reduceAll, initialState, type ViewState } from '@/lib/reducer'
5	import { DEMO_STEP_MS, DEMOS, loadDemo } from '@/lib/replay'
6	import type { Event, RunRecord } from '@/lib/types'
7	
8	const log = getLogger('web')
9	
10	export interface ReplayState {
11	  record: RunRecord | null
12	  events: Event[]
13	  /** View folded from the first `cursor` events. */
14	  state: ViewState
15	  cursor: number
16	  setCursor: (n: number) => void
17	  playing: boolean
18	  setPlaying: (p: boolean) => void
19	  restart: () => void
20	  loading: boolean
21	  error: string | null
22	  /** true while auto-advancing and not at the end */
23	  live: boolean
24	  done: boolean
25	}
26	
27	interface Loaded {
28	  demoId: string
29	  record: RunRecord | null
30	  error: string | null
31	}
32	
33	interface Playhead {
34	  demoId: string
35	  cursor: number
36	  playing: boolean
37	}
38	
39	/**
40	 * Scrubbable playback of a bundled RunRecord: the view is a pure fold of the first `cursor`
41	 * events, so the slider can move in both directions and the transcript, workspace and story stay
42	 * consistent with each other.
43	 *
44	 * State is keyed by `demoId` (the loaded record and the playhead both remember which demo they
45	 * belong to), so switching demos resets by derivation rather than by setState inside an effect.
46	 */
47	export function useReplay(demoId: string): ReplayState {
48	  const [loaded, setLoaded] = useState<Loaded | null>(null)
49	  const [playhead, setPlayhead] = useState<Playhead>({ demoId, cursor: 0, playing: true })
50	
51	  useEffect(() => {
52	    let cancelled = false
53	    const meta = DEMOS.find((d) => d.id === demoId)
54	    void (async () => {
55	      try {
56	        if (!meta) throw new Error(`no bundled demo named "${demoId}"`)
57	        const rec = await loadDemo(meta.file)
58	        if (cancelled) return
59	        setLoaded({ demoId, record: rec, error: null })
60	        log.info('replay.loaded', 'bundled run loaded', { demo: demoId, events: rec.events.length })
61	      } catch (err) {
62	        if (cancelled) return
63	        setLoaded({ demoId, record: null, error: String(err) })
64	        log.error('replay.error', 'failed to load bundled run', { demo: demoId, error: String(err) })
65	      }
66	    })()
67	    return () => {
68	      cancelled = true
69	    }
70	  }, [demoId])
71	
72	  const current = loaded && loaded.demoId === demoId ? loaded : null
73	  const record = current?.record ?? null
74	  const loading = current === null
75	  const error = current?.error ?? null
76	
77	  const head = playhead.demoId === demoId ? playhead : { demoId, cursor: 0, playing: true }
78	  const events = useMemo(() => record?.events ?? [], [record])
79	  const total = events.length
80	  const cursor = Math.min(head.cursor, total)
81	  // Playing past the end is meaningless, so "playing" is derived rather than switched off.
82	  const playing = head.playing && (record === null || cursor < total)
83	
84	  useEffect(() => {
85	    if (!playing || !record || cursor >= total) return
86	    const t = setTimeout(
87	      () =>
88	        setPlayhead((h) =>
89	          h.demoId === demoId ? { ...h, cursor: Math.min(h.cursor + 1, total) } : h,
90	        ),
91	      DEMO_STEP_MS,
92	    )
93	    return () => clearTimeout(t)
94	  }, [playing, cursor, total, record, demoId])
95	
96	  const base = useMemo(() => {
97	    if (!record) return initialState()
98	    const seeded = fromRunRecord({
99	      ...record,
100	      events: [],
101	      evaluation: null,
102	      finished_at: null,
103	      error: null,
104	      error_class: null,
105	      interruptions: [],
106	      worker_generation: 1,
107	    })
108	    return { ...seeded, status: 'running' as const, evaluation: null }
109	  }, [record])
110	
111	  const state = useMemo(() => reduceAll(events.slice(0, cursor), base), [events, cursor, base])
112	
113	  const setCursor = useCallback(
114	    (n: number) => setPlayhead({ demoId, cursor: Math.max(0, Math.min(n, total)), playing: false }),
115	    [demoId, total],
116	  )
117	  const setPlaying = useCallback(
118	    (p: boolean) =>
119	      setPlayhead((h) => ({ demoId, cursor: h.demoId === demoId ? h.cursor : 0, playing: p })),
120	    [demoId],
121	  )
122	  const restart = useCallback(() => setPlayhead({ demoId, cursor: 0, playing: true }), [demoId])
123	
124	  return {
125	    record,
126	    events,
127	    state,
128	    cursor,
129	    setCursor,
130	    playing,
131	    setPlaying,
132	    restart,
133	    loading,
134	    error,
135	    live: playing && cursor < total,
136	    done: total > 0 && cursor >= total,
137	  }
138	}

1	/**
2	 * Bundled replays: `public/demo/<scenario>.json` holds a RunRecord captured from a real run
3	 * (scripts/export_demo.py; see public/demo/README.md). `hooks/useReplay.ts` folds it through the
4	 * same reducer a live run goes through, one event every DEMO_STEP_MS, so the UI is fully
5	 * exercisable with no backend at all.
6	 */
7	
8	import type { RunRecord } from './types'
9	
10	export const DEMO_STEP_MS = 400
11	
12	export interface DemoMeta {
13	  id: string
14	  label: string
15	  file: string
16	}
17	
18	/** Demos shipped in public/demo. Adding a file here is all it takes to expose a new replay. */
19	export const DEMOS: DemoMeta[] = [
20	  // Real captures: claude-haiku-4-5 on the deployed stack (2026-09-12), exported with
21	  // scripts/export_demo.py. Ids match scenario ids so the scenario table offers them via demoFor().
22	  { id: 'lost-ack', label: 'lost-ack', file: '/demo/lost-ack.json' },
23	  { id: 'locked-file', label: 'locked-file', file: '/demo/locked-file.json' },
24	  { id: 'missing-config', label: 'missing-config', file: '/demo/missing-config.json' },
25	  { id: 'gauntlet', label: 'gauntlet', file: '/demo/gauntlet.json' },
26	]
27	
28	export function demoFor(scenarioId: string): DemoMeta | undefined {
29	  return DEMOS.find((d) => d.id === scenarioId)
30	}
31	
32	export async function loadDemo(
33	  file: string,
34	  fetchImpl: typeof fetch = fetch,
35	): Promise<RunRecord> {
36	  const res = await fetchImpl(file, { cache: 'no-store' })
37	  if (!res.ok) throw new Error(`demo ${file} not found (${res.status})`)
38	  const rec = (await res.json()) as RunRecord
39	  if (!Array.isArray(rec?.events)) throw new Error(`demo ${file} has no events`)
40	  return rec
41	}

1	# `components/bui` — Beautiful UI ports
2	
3	Components adapted from [Beautiful UI](https://www.beautifului.dev) (MIT, © 2026 Shane Levine —
4	see [LICENSE](./LICENSE)) and rewired to this app's run-view types (`src/lib/reducer.ts`,
5	`src/lib/types.ts`). Look, motion and structure follow the originals; demo data, scripted timers
6	and the `glimm` / `@central-icons-react` / `atoms` dependencies were replaced.
7	
8	| File | Origin | Adaptations |
9	| --- | --- | --- |
10	| `AssistantText.tsx` | `StreamingText` | Text comes from `turn.text` events instead of a word-by-word demo. Keeps the prose style and the streaming cursor; the last line shimmers while `streaming`. Sources, action buttons and follow-ups removed. Newlines preserved; `` `code` `` and `**bold**` spans styled inline, no markdown library. |
11	| `ThinkingTrace.tsx` | `ThinkingState` ("Steps") | Header shimmers while `active`, settles when `done`. Rows are `ToolCallView`s (tool icon, label, command/path, spinner / check / cross, `FaultFiredBadge`, `RecoveredBadge` — the latter is the "read-back seen" hint). Optional `thinking` paragraph; `children` render inside the expanded body. Stage timers removed; `defaultOpen` (else open while active). |
12	| `ToolCallChips.tsx` | `ToolChips` | One row per call with the icon→chevron hover swap and the mono chip. Expansion is inline (grid-rows reveal) instead of a hover portal so it works in a scrolling column. Body shows input, every result part the timeline shows (error + code, stdout, stderr, content, entries, bytes written, truncation), `exit n` / ok / error / no ack / not executed pill (`lib/callStatus.ts`, structured fields only), duration, fault-origin + read-back badges, and the unified diff (`CodeBlock`) for a mutating call with a matching `FileDiff`. `+n −m` count on the row. |
13	| `CodeBlock.tsx` | `CodeBlock` | Takes raw `code` or unified `diff` text (parsed here: `---`/`+++` meta, `@@` hunks drive line numbers, `+`/`-` tinted with the original's left bar / hatch). Copy button guarded on `navigator.clipboard`. Keyword tint extended with Python. No `fetch`. |
14	| `ScoreRows.tsx` | `TaskRows` ("Capsules") | Score headline (score/100, tests passed/failed/errors, checks ok/total) then one capsule per `Check` (round pass/fail badge, id, weight, pill) expanding to the detail, plus a pytest capsule expanding to a `CodeBlock`. Running / retry sequence removed. |
15	| `LoadingState.tsx` | `LoadingState` ("Drive") | Pixel-grid loader, shimmer label, elapsed clock. Video "Surfer" variant dropped; `sublabel` added. |
16	| `FileStatusTable.tsx` | `DiffTable` | Card + table + dotted status pill kept. Rows are `FileEntry`s (status, path, size via `fmtBytes`, short sha), changed files first, added/deleted rows tinted. Toggle/apply flow removed; optional `onSelect` / `selected` make rows focusable. |
17	| `Composer.tsx` | `PromptBar` ("Rounded", `demo=false`) | `/` at the start opens the scenario list above the bar (arrow keys, Enter/Tab pick, Esc dismiss, sliding hover highlight); picking sets `scenarioId` and fills the prompt with `task_prompt`. Model chip is a shadcn `DropdownMenu` radio group; seed chip is a small numeric input; Enter sends, Shift+Enter newlines; `hint` under the bar. `@` sources, attachments, dictation and the shader/sound celebration removed. |
18	
19	## Tokens
20	
21	The originals use `ink`, `ink-2`, `ink-3`, `canvas`, `surface`, `line`, `line-strong` and
22	`accent*`. shadcn already owns `accent`, so the port uses `brand*`; both sets are bridged to the
23	shadcn palette in the `@theme inline` block appended to `src/index.css`. Semantic colours
24	(`green`/`red`/`orange`) map to the app's existing `emerald` / `rose` / `amber` usage.
25	
26	## Motion
27	
28	Keyframes and the `.bui-*` animation classes live at the end of `src/index.css` under
29	`@media (prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference)`; transitions use Tailwind's `motion-safe:`
30	variant. With reduced motion every animation is a no-op and the shimmer renders as static text.

1	#!/usr/bin/env python3
2	"""Static file server for the built Faultline SPA.
3	
4	`python -m http.server` is not enough here: it has no SPA fallback (a refresh on `/?run=…` is
5	fine, but any future path route would 404), no cache-control, and its log format is not the
6	unified JSON we use everywhere else. This is ~150 lines and does exactly what the deployment
7	needs and nothing more.
8	
9	Behaviour:
10	  * serves `--root` (default /site)
11	  * SPA fallback: an *extension-less* path that does not exist is answered with index.html (200),
12	    so the app boots and reads the route itself; a missing `/assets/x.js` still 404s honestly
13	  * `index.html` and `config.json` are `no-store` — the point of config.json is that redeploying
14	    the harness changes it without rebuilding the frontend, so it must never be cached
15	  * hashed build output under `/assets/` is immutable for a year
16	  * one unified JSON log line per request on stdout, `svc:"web-server"`, flushed (stdout is block
17	    buffered when it is not a TTY, which it never is inside a container)
18	
19	Run standalone:  python serve.py --root dist --port 8000 --harness-url https://…
20	"""
21	
22	from __future__ import annotations
23	
24	import argparse
25	import json
26	import mimetypes
27	import os
28	import posixpath
29	import sys
30	import time
31	from datetime import datetime, timezone
32	from functools import partial
33	from http.server import SimpleHTTPRequestHandler, ThreadingHTTPServer
34	from pathlib import Path
35	from urllib.parse import unquote, urlsplit
36	
37	SVC = "web-server"
38	
39	# Content types the stdlib can get wrong (or miss) depending on the base image.
40	_EXTRA_TYPES = {
41	    ".js": "text/javascript; charset=utf-8",
42	    ".mjs": "text/javascript; charset=utf-8",
43	    ".css": "text/css; charset=utf-8",
44	    ".json": "application/json; charset=utf-8",
45	    ".map": "application/json; charset=utf-8",
46	    ".svg": "image/svg+xml",
47	    ".woff": "font/woff",
48	    ".woff2": "font/woff2",
49	    ".ttf": "font/ttf",
50	    ".wasm": "application/wasm",
51	    ".webmanifest": "application/manifest+json",
52	    ".md": "text/markdown; charset=utf-8",
53	}
54	for _ext, _ct in _EXTRA_TYPES.items():
55	    mimetypes.add_type(_ct.split(";")[0], _ext)
56	
57	IMMUTABLE_PREFIXES = ("/assets/",)
58	NEVER_CACHE_NAMES = {"index.html", "config.json"}
59	
60	
61	def _now() -> str:
62	    return datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(timespec="milliseconds").replace("+00:00", "Z")
63	
64	
65	def log(ev: str, msg: str = "", lvl: str = "info", **extras: object) -> None:
66	    """One unified JSON line, same field names as faultline_common.log."""
67	    rec: dict[str, object] = {"ts": _now(), "svc": SVC, "lvl": lvl, "ev": ev, "msg": msg}
68	    for key, value in extras.items():
69	        if value is not None:
70	            rec[key] = value
71	    sys.stdout.write(json.dumps(rec, default=str, ensure_ascii=False) + "\n")
72	    sys.stdout.flush()
73	
74	
75	class SpaHandler(SimpleHTTPRequestHandler):
76	    """SimpleHTTPRequestHandler + SPA fallback + cache headers + unified logging."""
77	
78	    server_version = "faultline-web"
79	    sys_version = ""
80	    protocol_version = "HTTP/1.1"
81	
82	    def __init__(self, *args: object, root: str = "/site", **kwargs: object) -> None:
83	        self._root = Path(root).resolve()
84	        self._fellback = False
85	        self._t0 = time.perf_counter()
86	        super().__init__(*args, directory=str(self._root), **kwargs)  # type: ignore[arg-type]
87	
88	    # ------------------------------------------------------------------ routing
89	
90	    def translate_path(self, path: str) -> str:
91	        full = Path(super().translate_path(path))
92	        if full.is_dir():
93	            index = full / "index.html"
94	            if index.is_file():
95	                return str(index)
96	        if full.exists():
97	            return str(full)
98	
99	        # SPA fallback, but only for something that looks like a route rather than an asset:
100	        # a missing hashed bundle must 404 so a broken deploy is visible instead of silently
101	        # serving HTML with a `text/javascript` expectation.
102	        name = posixpath.basename(unquote(urlsplit(self.path).path))
103	        if "." not in name:
104	            index = self._root / "index.html"
105	            if index.is_file():
106	                self._fellback = True
107	                return str(index)
108	        return str(full)
109	
110	    # ------------------------------------------------------------------ headers
111	
112	    def send_response_only(self, code: object, message: str | None = None) -> None:
113	        # Remember the status so end_headers() can decide whether this response is cacheable.
114	        try:
115	            self._status = int(code)  # type: ignore[arg-type]
116	        except (TypeError, ValueError):
117	            self._status = 0
118	        super().send_response_only(code, message)  # type: ignore[arg-type]
119	
120	    def end_headers(self) -> None:
121	        req_path = unquote(urlsplit(self.path).path)
122	        name = posixpath.basename(req_path)
123	        status = getattr(self, "_status", 200)
124	        if status >= 400:
125	            # NEVER cache an error. A 404 on a hashed `/assets/…` path is transient (it happens for
126	            # a few seconds during a redeploy, while a container still serves the previous image)
127	            # but the immutable one-year policy below would pin it in the browser cache forever and
128	            # leave that visitor staring at a blank page. Observed in the wild; do not "simplify".
129	            self.send_header("Cache-Control", "no-store")
130	        elif self._fellback or name in NEVER_CACHE_NAMES or req_path in ("", "/"):
131	            self.send_header("Cache-Control", "no-store, no-cache, must-revalidate")
132	        elif any(req_path.startswith(p) for p in IMMUTABLE_PREFIXES):
133	            self.send_header("Cache-Control", "public, max-age=31536000, immutable")
134	        else:
135	            self.send_header("Cache-Control", "public, max-age=300")
136	        self.send_header("X-Content-Type-Options", "nosniff")
137	        self.send_header("Referrer-Policy", "no-referrer")
138	        super().end_headers()
139	
140	    # ------------------------------------------------------------------ logging
141	
142	    def handle_one_request(self) -> None:
143	        self._t0 = time.perf_counter()
144	        self._fellback = False
145	        super().handle_one_request()
146	
147	    def log_request(self, code: object = "-", size: object = "-") -> None:
148	        try:
149	            status = int(code)  # type: ignore[arg-type]
150	        except (TypeError, ValueError):
151	            status = 0
152	        log(
153	            "http.request",
154	            f"{self.command} {self.path}",
155	            lvl="info" if status < 400 else "warn",
156	            method=self.command,
157	            path=self.path,
158	            status=status,
159	            bytes=size if size != "-" else None,
160	            dur_ms=int((time.perf_counter() - self._t0) * 1000),
161	            spa_fallback=True if self._fellback else None,
162	        )
163	
164	    def log_error(self, fmt: str, *args: object) -> None:
165	        log("http.error", fmt % args if args else fmt, lvl="warn", path=self.path)
166	
167	    def log_message(self, fmt: str, *args: object) -> None:  # pragma: no cover - silenced
168	        return
169	
170	
171	def write_config(root: Path, harness_url: str) -> None:
172	    """Runtime config the SPA fetches before its first request to the harness."""
173	    root.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
174	    target = root / "config.json"
175	    payload = {"harnessUrl": harness_url, "generatedAt": _now()}
176	    target.write_text(json.dumps(payload, indent=2) + "\n")
177	    log("config.written", "wrote runtime config", path=str(target), harness_url=harness_url)
178	
179	
180	def main(argv: list[str] | None = None) -> int:
181	    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description="Serve the built Faultline SPA.")
182	    parser.add_argument("--root", default=os.environ.get("SITE_ROOT", "/site"))
183	    parser.add_argument("--port", type=int, default=int(os.environ.get("PORT", "8000")))
184	    parser.add_argument("--host", default="0.0.0.0")
185	    parser.add_argument(
186	        "--harness-url",
187	        default=os.environ.get("HARNESS_URL"),
188	        help="written to <root>/config.json before serving; omit to leave any existing file alone",
189	    )
190	    args = parser.parse_args(argv)
191	
192	    root = Path(args.root).resolve()
193	    if not (root / "index.html").is_file():
194	        log("startup.error", f"no index.html under {root}", lvl="error", root=str(root))
195	        return 2
196	
197	    if args.harness_url:
198	        write_config(root, args.harness_url)
199	
200	    handler = partial(SpaHandler, root=str(root))
201	    httpd = ThreadingHTTPServer((args.host, args.port), handler)  # type: ignore[arg-type]
202	    httpd.daemon_threads = True
203	    log(
204	        "startup.ok",
205	        "serving",
206	        root=str(root),
207	        port=args.port,
208	        files=sum(1 for _ in root.rglob("*") if _.is_file()),
209	        harness_url=args.harness_url,
210	    )
211	    try:
212	        httpd.serve_forever()
213	    except KeyboardInterrupt:  # pragma: no cover
214	        log("shutdown", "interrupted")
215	    finally:
216	        httpd.server_close()
217	    return 0
218	
219	
220	if __name__ == "__main__":
221	    raise SystemExit(main())
222

1	"""Modal app `faultline-web` — hosts the built SPA as a static site.
2	
3	    modal deploy -e local apps/web/modal_app.py
4	    HARNESS_URL=https://…harness-api.modal.run modal deploy -e local apps/web/modal_app.py
5	
6	URL shape (workspace `appliedlabsai`, environment `local`, Server named `site`):
7	
8	    https://appliedlabsai-local--faultline-web-site.modal.run
9	
10	Two build paths, because the fast one is fast and the slow one is the one that works on a clean
11	checkout:
12	
13	  * **prebuilt** (default when `apps/web/dist/index.html` exists, or `FAULTLINE_WEB_PREBUILT=1`):
14	    `pnpm build` already ran locally, so the image just copies `dist/` to `/site`. No node in the
15	    image, build takes seconds.
16	  * **in-image**: no local `dist/`, so the image installs node 22 + pnpm and runs
17	    `pnpm install --frozen-lockfile && pnpm build` itself. Slower and it re-builds the image on
18	    every source change, but it needs nothing on the developer's machine.
19	    Force it with `FAULTLINE_WEB_PREBUILT=0`.
20	
21	  `add_local_dir(copy=False)` — the default — mounts at *container start*, i.e. after the image is
22	  built, so a `run_commands("pnpm build")` would see an empty /src. Both paths therefore use
23	  `copy=True`.
24	
25	The harness URL is **not** baked into the bundle. `/site/config.json` is written at container
26	start from `$HARNESS_URL` (see `serve.py`), and the SPA prefers it over the build-time
27	`VITE_HARNESS_URL`. Redeploying the harness is then `modal deploy` with a different env var, not a
28	frontend rebuild.
29	"""
30	
31	from __future__ import annotations
32	
33	import os
34	import subprocess
35	import sys
36	from pathlib import Path
37	
38	import modal
39	
40	# This module is imported twice: once locally at deploy time (where it sits at
41	# <repo>/apps/web/modal_app.py and has to build the image) and once inside the container (where it
42	# sits at /root/modal_app.py and must not touch the local filesystem at all). Everything
43	# path-dependent below is therefore guarded by `modal.is_local()`.
44	LOCAL = modal.is_local()
45	
46	_WEB_DIR = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
47	if LOCAL:
48	    # Make `faultline_common` importable at deploy time; inside the image
49	    # `add_local_python_source` has already put it on the path.
50	    _COMMON = _WEB_DIR.parents[1] / "packages" / "common"
51	    if (_COMMON / "faultline_common").is_dir() and str(_COMMON) not in sys.path:
52	        sys.path.insert(0, str(_COMMON))
53	
54	from faultline_common.log import get_logger  # noqa: E402
55	
56	log = get_logger("web")
57	
58	APP_NAME = "faultline-web"
59	SERVER_NAME = "site"
60	PORT = 8000
61	SITE_ROOT = "/site"
62	
63	DEFAULT_HARNESS_URL = "https://appliedlabsai-local--faultline-harness-api.modal.run"
64	HARNESS_URL = os.environ.get("HARNESS_URL", DEFAULT_HARNESS_URL).rstrip("/")
65	
66	DIST_DIR = _WEB_DIR / "dist"
67	SERVE_PY = _WEB_DIR / "serve.py"
68	
69	
70	def _use_prebuilt() -> bool:
71	    override = os.environ.get("FAULTLINE_WEB_PREBUILT")
72	    if override is not None:
73	        return override.strip().lower() in {"1", "true", "yes", "on"}
74	    return (DIST_DIR / "index.html").is_file()
75	
76	
77	PREBUILT = _use_prebuilt() if LOCAL else True
78	
79	# Files that must never enter the image in the in-image build path. node_modules alone is ~300 MB.
80	_IGNORE = [
81	    "node_modules",
82	    "**/node_modules",
83	    "**/node_modules/**",
84	    "dist",
85	    "dist/**",
86	    ".venv",
87	    ".venv/**",
88	    ".turbo",
89	    ".vite",
90	    "**/*.tsbuildinfo",
91	    "**/.DS_Store",
92	]
93	
94	_BASE = modal.Image.debian_slim(python_version="3.11").env(
95	    {
96	        # Build-time fallback only; /site/config.json written at container start wins.
97	        "VITE_HARNESS_URL": HARNESS_URL,
98	        "HARNESS_URL": HARNESS_URL,
99	        "SITE_ROOT": SITE_ROOT,
100	        "PORT": str(PORT),
101	        "PYTHONUNBUFFERED": "1",
102	    }
103	)
104	
105	if not LOCAL:
106	    # In the container the image already exists; re-declaring local mounts would only fail.
107	    IMAGE = _BASE
108	elif PREBUILT:
109	    IMAGE = (
110	        _BASE.add_local_file(str(SERVE_PY), "/opt/serve.py", copy=True)
111	        .add_local_dir(str(DIST_DIR), SITE_ROOT, copy=True)
112	        .add_local_python_source("faultline_common")
113	    )
114	else:
115	    IMAGE = (
116	        _BASE.apt_install("curl", "ca-certificates")
117	        .run_commands(
118	            "curl -fsSL https://deb.nodesource.com/setup_22.x | bash -",
119	            "apt-get install -y nodejs",
120	            "npm install -g pnpm@9.15.4",
121	        )
122	        .add_local_file(str(SERVE_PY), "/opt/serve.py", copy=True)
123	        .add_local_dir(str(_WEB_DIR), "/src", copy=True, ignore=_IGNORE)
124	        .run_commands(
125	            "cd /src && pnpm install --frozen-lockfile",
126	            "cd /src && pnpm build",
127	            f"mkdir -p {SITE_ROOT} && cp -r /src/dist/. {SITE_ROOT}/",
128	        )
129	        .add_local_python_source("faultline_common")
130	    )
131	
132	app = modal.App(APP_NAME)
133	
134	log.info(
135	    "deploy.config",
136	    "image selected",
137	    app=APP_NAME,
138	    prebuilt=PREBUILT,
139	    dist=str(DIST_DIR) if PREBUILT else None,
140	    harness_url=HARNESS_URL,
141	)
142	
143	
144	@app.server(
145	    image=IMAGE,
146	    name=SERVER_NAME,
147	    port=PORT,
148	    unauthenticated=True,
149	    # A Server scaled to zero answers 503 rather than queueing, so keep one warm.
150	    min_containers=1,
151	    startup_timeout=60,
152	)
153	class Site:
154	    """Serves /site on :8000. `serve.py` writes config.json from $HARNESS_URL first."""
155	
156	    @modal.enter()
157	    def start(self) -> None:
158	        harness_url = os.environ.get("HARNESS_URL", DEFAULT_HARNESS_URL).rstrip("/")
159	        log.info(
160	            "server.start",

162	            root=SITE_ROOT,

170	                "--root",
171	                SITE_ROOT,
172	                "--port",
173	                str(PORT),
174	                "--harness-url",
175	                harness_url,
176	            ],
177	            stdout=None,
178	            stderr=None,

181	    @modal.exit()
182	    def stop(self) -> None:
183	        proc = getattr(self, "proc", None)
184	        if proc is None:
185	            return
186	        log.info("server.stop", "terminating static server", pid=proc.pid)
187	        proc.terminate()
188	        try:
189	            proc.wait(timeout=5)
190	        except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:  # pragma: no cover
191	            proc.kill()

77	function dayBucket(iso: string, now = new Date()): string {
78	  const d = new Date(iso)
79	  if (Number.isNaN(d.getTime())) return 'Earlier'
80	  const startOfToday = new Date(now.getFullYear(), now.getMonth(), now.getDate()).getTime()
81	  const t = d.getTime()
82	  if (t >= startOfToday) return 'Today'
83	  if (t >= startOfToday - 86_400_000) return 'Yesterday'
84	  if (t >= startOfToday - 6 * 86_400_000) return 'Previous 7 days'
85	  return 'Earlier'
86	}
87	
88	function groupByDay(items: ConversationSummary[]): { label: string; items: ConversationSummary[] }[] {
89	  const order = ['Today', 'Yesterday', 'Previous 7 days', 'Earlier']
90	  const buckets = new Map<string, ConversationSummary[]>()
91	  for (const c of items) {
92	    const key = dayBucket(c.updated_at || c.created_at)
93	    const arr = buckets.get(key) ?? []
94	    arr.push(c)
95	    buckets.set(key, arr)
96	  }
97	  return order.filter((k) => buckets.has(k)).map((k) => ({ label: k, items: buckets.get(k)! }))
98	}

100	function shortId(userId: string | null): string {
